HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITS: Origin means inspected antecedent, not an assertion of absolute first invention

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.SUPPORT: Named language definitions and explicit counterexamples where applicable; no general effectiveness theorem
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITS: The four-valued rule is an operational reconstruction; authority and world correspondence are not logically supplied by syntax

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.SUPPORT: S027 compares linguistic features using a domain-modeling outcome. S028 compares generation/pipeline outputs using reference alignment and human judgments. Their different measures illustrate evidence-scope limits. S020/S030 separately supply case/documentation context.
EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITS: Neither comparative source tests the combined verification/need/outcome/acceptance mechanism, and neither validates receiving authority or net workflow benefit from the proposed schema.

SOURCE_ROLES.ERE-S-S027: ADJACENT_LINGUISTIC_QUALITY_EXPERIMENT; not a test or replication of four-part acceptance partitioning
SOURCE_ROLES.ERE-S-S028: ADJACENT_GENERATION_EVALUATION; not a test of four-part acceptance partitioning

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.SUPPORT: S027 conceptually replicates a passive-voice/domain-modeling subclaim from Femmer et al. (2014), as described in S027; it does not replicate the four-part verification/need/outcome/acceptance mechanism.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.LIMITS: The earlier experiment and its reanalysis are known here through S027, not independently re-inspected sources. No direct replication of the combined partitioning rule is established in the linked inspected set; no broader absence claim is made.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.ORIGINAL_OR_REPLICATED_CLAIM: Original question: effects of passive versus active requirements sentences on domain modeling. S027 changes the design and adds ambiguous-pronoun/context questions; only the passive-voice hypothesis is the conceptual-replication part.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.POPULATION_TASK_AND_OUTCOME: S027 describes the original 15-student/seven-requirement experiment; its new experiment uses 25 industry/university participants and four single-sentence modeling tasks, measuring missing entities and associations and other model errors.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.DEPENDENCE: The new conceptual replication collects new data; the prior reanalysis reuses the original data and is not another independent experiment. Design/materials differ; numerical results are not directly interchangeable.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.TRANSFER_TO_RETAINED_PROPERTY: Adjacent support for keeping a measured outcome distinct from broader quality/acceptance claims. It neither tests receiving authority nor measures the effect of the synthesized four-part schema.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.SUPPORT: Qualitative practitioner cases or source-document rewrite; distinctions in source records apply
INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.LIMITS: Reported practices and perceptions are not randomized process benefits or universal prevalence

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.SUPPORT: An elaborate assurance record can become ritual; tests and signatures can be redundant or misunderstand the need.
NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.LIMITS: A paper’s open problem is not an observed failure; the constructed cases are not incident reports

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.SUPPORT: No external standard mandate asserted in this research sublane
STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.LIMITS: Language conventions and an author’s chosen criterion do not grant normative authority; cited ISO editions not independently adopted

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.SUPPORT: Test traces, observed outcomes, criterion mapping, negative-case checks and scoped acceptance decision.
PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: A tool’s existence/performance on selected examples does not establish organizational success

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.SUPPORT: A delivery service verifies message enqueueing, then separately observes recipient receipt in the relevant channel; the receiving owner accepts only the supported service scope.
TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.LIMITS: Constructed examples expose distinctions; they are not evidence of implementation effectiveness in a target repository

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.SUPPORT: An authorized party can accept residual risk without making an unsupported proposition true; latent outcomes may remain unobserved.
CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: Contrary findings narrow claims; they do not justify symmetric overgeneralization

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.SUPPORT: The intended need and receiving remit can be identified; evidence is tied to the actual configuration/environment.
ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.LIMITS: Changed build, data population, external service, criterion or receiving remit reopens the corresponding evidence dimension.

DOMAIN_VALIDITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Separating specified conformance, actual need, observed outcome and acceptance.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.SUPPORT: Inquiry analysis, requirement/test documentation reports and one instrumented BDD case show why evidence must name its claim, configuration and context. S027/S028 additionally show that one quality or reference-alignment outcome does not settle all others.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.LIMITS: The four-part synthesis is not itself empirically validated; adjacent quality and generation studies support inference limits, not the complete acceptance mechanism.

LOCATORS.LOCATOR: pp. 22–24, 29–31; inquiry cycle and level-of-effort discussion

STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Participation and receiving roles in requirements/test decisions.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.SUPPORT: S030 reports technical-role involvement and update problems across 20 practitioners; S017 and S021 give conceptual grounds for retaining questions, sources and consumers.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.LIMITS: These sources neither establish representation of all affected people nor demonstrate that the proposed acceptance record reliably obtains it.

LOCATORS.LOCATOR: pp. 22–24, 29–31; inquiry cycle and level-of-effort discussion

NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: The legitimacy of the receiving authority in the four-part assessment.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.SUPPORT: The schema requires an independently identified remit and distinguishes acceptance from factual truth. The linked empirical studies do not test whether a decision-maker is authorized for every affected requirement.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.LIMITS: The proposed authority field is a design requirement, not evidence of a valid mandate; no applicable external norm was adjudicated by this research record.

REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.SUPPORT: This mechanism partitions evidential and decision claims; it supplies no formal goal decomposition or proof that a lower-level specification preserves a higher-level obligation.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.LIMITS: Any refinement used by a consumer must be assessed separately from the four-part evidence record.

REALIZABILITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Whether the partitioned acceptance schema proves a system realizable.
REALIZABILITY.SUPPORT: A schema can record feasibility or observed outcome evidence but does not establish it. The single BDD case demonstrates instrumented checks in one setting, not existence of an implementation for arbitrary requirements.
REALIZABILITY.LIMITS: Unobserved environments, external actors and unverified capability assumptions remain unresolved by schema completion.

TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Criterion-to-requirement/test links at the configuration actually assessed.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.SUPPORT: S021 and S030 support retaining source, consumer and update context; S020 illustrates binding agreed performance thresholds to observations.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.LIMITS: These sources do not test the accuracy or maintenance performance of the complete four-part trace chain; stale or mismatched links require separate assessment.

ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: What an instrumented check and an acceptance decision respectively warrant.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.SUPPORT: S020 shows concrete performance criteria connected to instruments in one vendor/team case; S030 identifies requirement/test documentation gaps. The synthesis uses those limits to keep criterion satisfaction and authorized acceptance distinct.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.LIMITS: No controlled comparison validates the full mechanism or proves external-need fulfillment from local checks; a signature cannot make an unsupported proposition true.

EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Operational checking, documentation problems and task-specific outcomes.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.SUPPORT: S020 supplies single-case feasibility, S030 supplies self-reported industrial problems, and S027/S028 supply distinct quality/reference-alignment outcomes. They motivate scoped evidence records.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.LIMITS: None is a trial of the combined conformance/need/outcome/acceptance partition rule, so its net workflow effectiveness is not established.

DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: A declared consuming rule over separately supported evidence statuses.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.SUPPORT: The proposed rule blocks substituting a local test result for unknown external outcomes and permits explicit risk acceptance without changing factual statuses. Source cases illustrate why the distinction matters.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.LIMITS: This is a researcher-designed decision discipline, not a calibrated or empirically validated acceptance algorithm; the consuming criterion and authority remain contextual.

LOCATORS.LOCATOR: pp. 22–24, 29–31; inquiry cycle and level-of-effort discussion

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Field requirement/test-documentation problems and bounded operational cases support the need for distinct links; no claim this combined schema itself has trial-proven effectiveness. Source access levels bind every claim; schema completeness is not domain validation.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Conformance, validity, outcome and acceptance are distinct even when one observation informs several; none automatically entails all others. An authorized party can accept residual risk without making an unsupported proposition true; latent outcomes may remain unobserved.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Use a negative control or changed external assumption that preserves local tests and see whether the acceptance conclusion is properly revised.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Use a negative control or changed external assumption that preserves local tests and see whether the acceptance conclusion is properly revised.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: The reviewers inspected the complete claim/disposition population and selected detailed semantics/source bodies. Absence of an individual finding does not establish independent validation of every field, source or proposed predicate.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONTEXT: inspect equivalent existing mechanism, guard, cheap path and evidence before considering any adoption
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: Exactly which claim does this evidence establish, for what configuration and environment, and who may accept the remaining limits?
Does a simpler existing mechanism already answer the same consumer question?
Which assumption, scope or authority change would require re-entry?
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: Local conformance, stakeholder approval and observed external success are interchangeable.
No finding about any target repository or semantic owner is supplied.

SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.INPUT: Criterion source, subject/configuration, environment, observation method, negative controls, evidence identity/date, evaluator and receiving authority.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.OUTPUT: State the exact claim and criterion, configuration/environment, evaluator/observer and receiving authority; maintain separate evidence statuses for conformance, need correspondence, real-world outcome and acceptance.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.CONSUMER: Receiving stakeholder, tester and assurance/decision reviewer.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.BOUNDARY: Conformance, validity, outcome and acceptance are distinct even when one observation informs several; none automatically entails all others.

VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.APPLICATION: Target-neutral schema applied to the property; worked cases are explicitly analytical
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.CLAIM: State the exact claim and criterion, configuration/environment, evaluator/observer and receiving authority; maintain separate evidence statuses for conformance, need correspondence, real-world outcome and acceptance.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.CRITERION: Evaluate each required dimension separately as PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/INAPPLICABLE. The consuming decision may PASS only under its declared rule over those statuses and current authority; an observed contradiction FAILS the affected dimension. A passed local test cannot fill UNKNOWN external-outcome or representation cells.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.SUBJECT_CONFIGURATION: An acceptance/satisfaction claim for a named requirement and delivered configuration
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.METHOD: Link prospective criterion to retrospective observation and a scoped decision; show which dimension is established and which depends on external actors, unobserved environments or authority.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.EVALUATOR: Named competent reviewer for the criterion; independence and shared priors disclosed
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.OBSERVER: Person/tool that actually observes the relevant behavior or task result
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.ENVIRONMENT: Conformance, validity, outcome and acceptance are distinct even when one observation informs several; none automatically entails all others.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.NEGATIVE_CONTROLS: The application reports email queued and all unit tests pass, but the downstream provider rejects the address and no user is notified; external notification remains failed.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.EVIDENCE: Test traces, observed outcomes, criterion mapping, negative-case checks and scoped acceptance decision.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.RECEIVING_AUTHORITY: Acceptance is an authorized decision with a scope and possible conditions, not a scientific fact or universal stakeholder consent.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.REMAINING_LIMITS: An authorized party can accept residual risk without making an unsupported proposition true; latent outcomes may remain unobserved.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Targeted fault-specific requirements inspection

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Porter–Votta–Basili1995 replicated inspection experiment
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Inspection scenarios prescribe systematic searches for particular fault classes.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Inspection scenarios prescribe systematic searches for particular fault classes.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Ad hoc reading or generic checklist completion may not direct attention to the defects a reviewer must find.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: ANALYTICAL_QUALIFICATION_OF_DOCUMENTED_BRANCH; see genealogy edges for evidence-backed historical relations

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Fault-specific scenario reading outperformed checklist/ad hoc under study conditions; meetings did not add net detection benefit
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ROLE: DIRECT_INSPECTION_METHOD_EVIDENCE and within-program replication; source-defined detection outcome and bounded transfer
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION: 48 graduate students, two small event-driven SRSs and constrained crossover; not all industrial reviews or negotiation; naturally occurring faults rather than deliberately seeded faults

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Consumer/task-relative quality effects; passive voice and ambiguous pronouns have different effects on domain modeling
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ROLE: ADJACENT_QUALITY_CONTEXT_AND_TRANSFER_LIMIT only: linguistic features in domain modeling; not inspection-method evidence or replication
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION: 25 participants/four single-sentence tasks; limited interaction power; context self-reports unvalidated; not a universal lint-weight derivation

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of absolute first invention. Inspection scenario means a fault-focused reading procedure, not a behavioral use case or BDD example.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Where known fault classes and a suitable specification exist, use concrete reading procedures targeted at those faults, with locally validated cost and detection value.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A requirements review and specified fault classes
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Ad hoc reading or generic checklist completion may not direct attention to the defects a reviewer must find.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Assign a reading procedure that guides the reviewer through representations/checks relevant to a fault, rather than merely naming a general quality.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retain targeted search with conditional comparisons and exploratory inquiry; distinguish a local useful finding, a comparative detection effect and net workflow benefit, and label qualitative practical cost justification as such.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Higher detection of the targeted faults under the studied conditions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: S026 reports better targeted-fault detection for scenario procedures in two study runs with 48 graduate students and two event-driven SRSs. This supports the stated comparative detection outcome, not an automatic total net benefit for every review workflow. The local-usefulness and cost judgments are separately scoped.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Review organizer choosing an inspection technique for a known risk.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Focused informal review or automated structural check when it discriminates the fault more cheaply.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Material known defect classes warrant inspection and can be operationalized as concrete reviewer tasks.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: An obvious low-impact textual correction does not need a team inspection.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Reviewers have appropriate domain/task competence; known faults represent relevant risks; technique costs are counted.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Inspection scenario means a fault-focused reading procedure, not a behavioral use case or BDD example.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Inspection scenario means a fault-focused reading procedure, not a behavioral use case or BDD example. Excludes any target repository finding or inter-lineage ownership assignment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Fault discovery informs a decision but does not itself settle stakeholder preference or authority.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Specification/version, risk/fault taxonomy, reading procedure, reviewer background, findings and adjudication.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.LIMIT: Relations are conditional; see internal_relations, not all listed items are mandatory prerequisites

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Reviewers tick “consistent” without applying any check, then cite the experiment as evidence their unrelated checklist must improve quality.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Preparation, training and false-positive adjudication; increasing detection may not justify every extra review stage.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Retire a procedure when its fault class or artifact form no longer applies; reenter if incidents or changed artifacts reveal recurrence.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Assess the expressly scoped comparative detection effect or net workflow benefit of targeted fault-specific inspection, while recording local useful findings as separate bounded observations.

EVALUATION_MODE.DEFINITION: Mode describes how evidence is assessed, separate from the commissioned predicate-role enum. A sufficiency challenge tests an asserted implication or universal process benefit; ordinary operational assessment evaluates the bounded source-informed rule. Mechanical record checks do not settle semantic, empirical or authority judgments.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Assess(subject: A requirements review and specified fault classes, context, consumerDecision, evidenceSnapshot, validTime) -> PASS|FAIL|UNKNOWN|INAPPLICABLE

VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS.CONSTRAINT: Separate individual, meeting and net findings

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: The empirical-effect verdict applies only to the explicitly selected comparative or net-benefit subclaim and the named artifacts, tasks, reviewers, comparison and observation window. A local useful finding supports only its observational subjudgment. No universal process-benefit or unstudied population inference follows.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A requirements review and specified fault classes
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Assessed at the named evidence/configuration snapshot. Hypothesized, desired, agreed and observed states remain distinct. Later changes require the stated invalidation procedure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Reviewers have appropriate domain/task competence; known faults represent relevant risks; technique costs are counted.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Material known defect classes warrant inspection and can be operationalized as concrete reviewer tasks.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Declare the assessed subclaim, artifact/version, fault class, reading procedure, reviewer scope and adjudicated results. LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING is a bounded observational subjudgment: an actual relevant, adjudicated finding with a demonstrated decision consequence may PASS without a comparator; this does not grant P01 an empirical-effect PASS. COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT may PASS only when an appropriate comparison supports the stated detection effect for the named artifact/task/reviewer scope with uncertainty and design limits recorded. NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT may PASS only when relevant comparative outcomes, setup/training/review effort, false positives, adjudication/correction burden and other material costs support the declared decision criterion. P01 retains EMPIRICAL_REGULARITY_HYPOTHESIS: its PASS is scoped to the supported comparative or net-effect subclaim, and cannot be obtained from a local useful finding alone. If required comparison or cost evidence is absent, the asserted stronger effect is UNKNOWN; an unrequested subclaim may be explicitly NOT_ASSESSED without a favorable verdict. A qualitative practical cost justification can support a bounded choice of review stage, but must be labeled qualitative and cannot be reported as a measured comparative or causal net effect. A completed checklist without a relevant search supplies no finding evidence; efficacy outside the supported scope remains UNKNOWN.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.LIMIT: Researcher reconstruction from the bounded inspection comparison; not a verbatim source theorem or a validated universal assessment algorithm. S027 supplies only adjacent quality-context caution elsewhere in this record.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: For local usefulness, retain the finding, adjudication and demonstrated decision change. For a comparative effect, add suitable comparator records, relevant detection outcomes and uncertainty. For net benefit, also retain setup/training/review effort, false positives, adjudication/correction and other material costs under the declared criterion.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Artifact/version, fault classes, actual procedure, reviewer scope and adjudicated findings for every assessment; claim-specific comparison and cost witnesses according to the three scoped subjudgments. A local-usefulness observation alone needs no comparative experiment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: An informed evaluator checks applicability, identifies the exact claim and scope, reviews the named witnesses, tests the supplied counterexample class and records a reasoned four-valued outcome. Mechanical schema checks can establish presence/identity, not domain truth or authority.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite record checks are mechanically decidable. Semantic correspondence, legitimate representation, proxy validity and causal transfer generally require contextual judgment and may remain UNKNOWN. No claim of general decidability.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.TEXT: A mode-transition reading procedure exposes a missing deactivation condition and adjudication changes the acceptance decision. This constructed example illustrates LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING only; without further comparison and cost evidence, comparative detection and net workflow benefit remain UNKNOWN/not assessed.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.TEXT: An expensive procedure finds an adjudicated omission that a cheaper adequate review also finds. Local usefulness can hold while comparative advantage or net benefit is unsupported or fails the declared criterion. Checklist completion without an actual relevant search supplies no local-finding evidence.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Required finding/decision evidence, comparison, material workflow costs or interpretation is missing or disputed for the selected subclaim. Local usefulness cannot fill missing comparative or net-effect evidence. Unrequested subclaims may be recorded NOT_ASSESSED; missing evidence never supplies a favorable empirical verdict.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A spelling correction with no changed meaning is checked by the owner directly.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: Promoting a local useful finding, a completed checklist or a qualitative cost rationale into measured comparative or causal net benefit.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: Demanding a comparative experiment when the consumer needs only a bounded local-usefulness observation or a clearly labeled qualitative practical choice.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An empty declared scope cannot pass merely because no obligations were listed: explain why the guard is inapplicable or why the scope is adequate. An inspection meeting or completed checklist is not equivalent to conducting a targeted search.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: New artifact style, reviewer population, fault distribution or task requires renewed transfer assessment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Preparation, training and false-positive adjudication; increasing detection may not justify every extra review stage. Alternative: An obvious low-impact textual correction does not need a team inspection.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: S026 supports bounded detection comparisons in two runs with 48 graduate students and two event-driven SRSs. Its within-program replication does not validate this operational rule or establish total net benefit in another workflow. LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING is observational; comparative and net-effect judgments require their respective evidence.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: Analytical operational reconstruction from inspected primary sources; no claim of a source-native theorem or universal algorithm.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Declare the assessed subclaim, artifact/version, fault class, reading procedure, reviewer scope and adjudicated results. LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING is a bounded observational subjudgment: an actual relevant, adjudicated finding with a demonstrated decision consequence may PASS without a comparator; this does not grant P01 an empirical-effect PASS. COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT may PASS only when an appropriate comparison supports the stated detection effect for the named artifact/task/reviewer scope with uncertainty and design limits recorded. NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT may PASS only when relevant comparative outcomes, setup/training/review effort, false positives, adjudication/correction burden and other material costs support the declared decision criterion. P01 retains EMPIRICAL_REGULARITY_HYPOTHESIS: its PASS is scoped to the supported comparative or net-effect subclaim, and cannot be obtained from a local useful finding alone. If required comparison or cost evidence is absent, the asserted stronger effect is UNKNOWN; an unrequested subclaim may be explicitly NOT_ASSESSED without a favorable verdict. A qualitative practical cost justification can support a bounded choice of review stage, but must be labeled qualitative and cannot be reported as a measured comparative or causal net effect. A completed checklist without a relevant search supplies no finding evidence; efficacy outside the supported scope remains UNKNOWN.

OUTCOMES.PASS: For P01, evidence supports the expressly selected comparative detection or net-benefit subclaim at its stated scope. LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING has its own observational verdict and cannot alone yield this empirical-effect PASS.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An applicable observed contradiction, failed criterion or valid counterexample defeats the specified claim
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: The selected claim lacks adequate relevant observations, comparison, costs or interpretation. Record which component is unknown; do not convert a narrower supported observation into a stronger effect.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: An explicit guard excludes the claim; cheap path must be justified

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.EMPTY_SCOPE_RULE: Empty obligation/source sets never establish completeness by vacuity; show scope adequacy or label inapplicable/unknown.

LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING.PASS_RULE: An actual relevant finding is adjudicated and its decision consequence is demonstrated at the named artifact/version; a comparator is unnecessary for this narrow observation.
LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING.FAIL_RULE: Evidence contradicts the asserted useful finding, its relevance or its claimed decision consequence.
LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING.UNKNOWN_RULE: Finding, adjudication, relevance or decision consequence is missing or disputed.
LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING.WITHHELD: Comparative superiority, general efficacy and net workflow benefit. Local PASS does not promote P01 empirical-effect status.

COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT.PASS_RULE: A suitable comparison supports the declared targeted detection effect with artifact/task/reviewer population, comparator, outcome and uncertainty stated.
COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT.FAIL_RULE: The applicable comparison contradicts the stated effect or fails its declared criterion; absence of comparison alone is UNKNOWN.
COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT.UNKNOWN_RULE: A relevant comparison or its interpretation is missing, inadequate or disputed. One local useful finding is insufficient.
COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT.WITHHELD: Net benefit until material total workflow costs/outcomes are assessed; causal interpretation beyond what the comparison design supports.

NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT.PASS_RULE: Relevant comparative outcomes and setup/training/review effort, false-positive/adjudication/correction burden and other material costs support the declared decision criterion within the named scope.
NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT.FAIL_RULE: Adequate scoped evidence fails the declared net-benefit criterion or establishes an applicable counterexample.
NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT.UNKNOWN_RULE: Required comparative outcomes, material costs or the decision criterion are missing or unresolved; positive detection alone is insufficient.
NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT.WITHHELD: Transfer beyond the evaluation scope and causal net-effect estimates unsupported by the design. A qualitative practical choice is recorded separately as qualitative justification.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.AGGREGATION_RULE: Do not collapse the three subjudgments into an unqualified review-benefit PASS. State which empirical subclaim P01 assesses. Local observational PASS alone leaves a claimed empirical comparison/net effect UNKNOWN; an unrequested stronger subclaim can be marked NOT_ASSESSED. A qualitative selection rationale is not an empirical-effect verdict.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: A mode-transition reading procedure exposes a missing deactivation condition and adjudication changes the acceptance decision. This constructed example illustrates LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING only; without further comparison and cost evidence, comparative detection and net workflow benefit remain UNKNOWN/not assessed.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE: An expensive procedure finds an adjudicated omission that a cheaper adequate review also finds. Local usefulness can hold while comparative advantage or net benefit is unsupported or fails the declared criterion. Checklist completion without an actual relevant search supplies no local-finding evidence.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE: A spelling correction with no changed meaning is checked by the owner directly.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: For local usefulness, retain the finding, adjudication and demonstrated decision change. For a comparative effect, add suitable comparator records, relevant detection outcomes and uncertainty. For net benefit, also retain setup/training/review effort, false positives, adjudication/correction and other material costs under the declared criterion. Missing claim-specific evidence remains UNKNOWN.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: New artifact style, reviewer population, fault distribution or task requires renewed transfer assessment.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: The strongest original experiment uses students and constrained documents; procedural guidance can miss unanticipated defects.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Reviewers tick “consistent” without applying any check, then cite the experiment as evidence their unrelated checklist must improve quality.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Treat comparative results as conditional, retain exploratory inquiry and test local usefulness.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Strengthens vague inspection advice into specified fault-search procedures while limiting empirical transfer.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Unknown faults, domain misunderstandings and representational blind spots remain.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: An inspection meeting or completed checklist is not equivalent to conducting a targeted search.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retain the bounded mechanism with explicit guard, evidence and cheap path. Treat comparative results as conditional, retain exploratory inquiry and test local usefulness.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Fault-specific scenario reading outperformed checklist/ad hoc under study conditions; meetings did not add net detection benefit
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: DIRECT_INSPECTION_METHOD_EVIDENCE and within-program replication; source-defined detection outcome and bounded transfer
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION: 48 graduate students, two small event-driven SRSs and constrained crossover; not all industrial reviews or negotiation; naturally occurring faults rather than deliberately seeded faults

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Consumer/task-relative quality effects; passive voice and ambiguous pronouns have different effects on domain modeling
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: ADJACENT_QUALITY_CONTEXT_AND_TRANSFER_LIMIT only: linguistic features in domain modeling; not inspection-method evidence or replication
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION: 25 participants/four single-sentence tasks; limited interaction power; context self-reports unvalidated; not a universal lint-weight derivation

CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM_CHALLENGED: All scenario-based reviews or any checklist are proven superior in every domain.
CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.QUALIFICATION: 48 graduate students, two small event-driven SRSs and constrained crossover; not all industrial reviews or negotiation; naturally occurring faults rather than deliberately seeded faults

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.SUPPORT: S026 supplies the inspected fault-specific reading method and two study runs. S027 is a later, different task-quality experiment used only to limit transfer.
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITS: Inspected antecedent, not a first-invention claim; adjacent quality work is not an inspection-method ancestor or replication.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.SUPPORT: Named language definitions and explicit counterexamples where applicable; no general effectiveness theorem
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITS: The four-valued rule is an operational reconstruction; authority and world correspondence are not logically supplied by syntax

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.SUPPORT: S026 reports two runs with 48 graduate students, 16 three-person teams and two small event-driven SRSs. Fault-specific scenario reading achieved better detection than the compared checklist/ad hoc techniques under the study conditions; meeting gains/losses were measured separately.
EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITS: The shared program, artifacts, population and constrained design limit transfer. S027 is a different linguistic-quality/domain-modeling experiment and supplies no inspection-method comparison. Detection evidence is not by itself evidence of total net workflow benefit.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.SUPPORT: S026 reports two runs of the same inspection program comparing fault-specific scenario reading with checklist and ad hoc reading. The results support a bounded detection comparison for the studied faults/artifacts.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.LIMITS: Shared investigators, materials and constrained design limit independence and transfer. The later professional replication was located only by abstract in this packet; that access limit is not evidence that external replications do not exist. S027 is excluded from inspection replication support.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.ORIGINAL_OR_REPLICATED_CLAIM: Systematic reading procedures targeted to particular fault classes improve detection relative to the compared general reading methods under the experiment conditions.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.POPULATION_TASK_AND_OUTCOME: Two 1993 runs, each with 24 graduate students; 48 total, 16 three-person teams. Teams inspect two event-driven SRSs; measured outcomes include individual/team detection and meeting gain/loss rates.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.DEPENDENCE: Both runs use the same research program and water-level/cruise-control specifications. Team assignment changes across runs and scenario-first teams remain constrained in later reading; this is not an independent-team industrial validation.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.TRANSFER_TO_RETAINED_PROPERTY: Supports the targeted-search method in the tested setting. It does not validate the researcher-proposed P01 as an acceptance algorithm or establish net value in another workflow.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.SUPPORT: Qualitative practitioner cases or source-document rewrite; distinctions in source records apply
INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.LIMITS: Reported practices and perceptions are not randomized process benefits or universal prevalence

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.SUPPORT: The strongest original experiment uses students and constrained documents; procedural guidance can miss unanticipated defects.
NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.LIMITS: A paper’s open problem is not an observed failure; the constructed cases are not incident reports

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.SUPPORT: No external standard mandate asserted in this research sublane
STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.LIMITS: Language conventions and an author’s chosen criterion do not grant normative authority; cited ISO editions not independently adopted

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.SUPPORT: S026 supplies concrete reading procedures and individual/team fault records for the experiment.
PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: Student execution and study worksheets do not demonstrate industrial adoption or net organizational return.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.SUPPORT: A mode-transition requirement review explicitly constructs transition cases and discovers a missing deactivation condition before acceptance.
TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.LIMITS: Constructed examples expose distinctions; they are not evidence of implementation effectiveness in a target repository

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.SUPPORT: Unknown faults, domain misunderstandings and representational blind spots remain.
CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: Contrary findings narrow claims; they do not justify symmetric overgeneralization

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.SUPPORT: Reviewers have appropriate domain/task competence; known faults represent relevant risks; technique costs are counted.
ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.LIMITS: New artifact style, reviewer population, fault distribution or task requires renewed transfer assessment.

DOMAIN_VALIDITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Fault-specific inspection of two event-driven requirements specifications.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.SUPPORT: S026 compares concrete scenarios, checklists and ad hoc reading on water-level and cruise-control specifications with naturally occurring faults. The finding supports targeted search in the studied artifact/fault setting.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.LIMITS: Mostly formal tabular specifications, small artifacts and constrained study design limit transfer to other domains, unknown fault classes and ordinary use-case scenarios.

STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.SUPPORT: The two runs in S026 involve 48 graduate students arranged into 16 three-person teams. Assigned reading responsibilities cover the selected fault classes.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.LIMITS: This is reviewer/task coverage, not representative coverage of industrial roles, affected stakeholders or legitimate preferences; professionals are not established by this experiment.

NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Whether a defect-detection result supplies stakeholder or legal authority.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.SUPPORT: The retained mechanism is a bounded inspection method. Finding a relevant omission can inform a decision without authorizing the requirement or the remedy.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.LIMITS: The study is not a normative source and does not establish a stakeholder mandate; local acceptance or prioritization authority must be supplied separately.

REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Whether targeted reading proves formal refinement correctness.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.SUPPORT: The scenario procedures guide searches for fault classes; their measured outcome is detection. They are not a refinement calculus or a completeness proof.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.LIMITS: A finding may expose an incorrect refinement, but a completed reading procedure does not prove every refinement step sound.

REALIZABILITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: A proof that requirements are implementable.
REALIZABILITY.SUPPORT: S026 evaluates inspection performance on given specifications. It demonstrates execution of the review procedure, not existence of a system satisfying the specification.
REALIZABILITY.LIMITS: Undetected inconsistency, impossible environmental assumptions and implementation limits can remain after inspection.

TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Connecting individual and meeting findings to adjudicated faults.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.SUPPORT: S026 uses individual/team fault summaries and a fault catalogue to evaluate detection and meeting gains/losses. That supplies task-local issue-to-fault correspondence for the experiment.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.LIMITS: This is not evidence of lifecycle trace accuracy, version maintenance or correctness of all source/test links in a new review.

ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: The conclusion warranted by one useful finding versus broader review benefit.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.SUPPORT: A source-defined detection outcome can support a bounded comparison. The reconstructed local-usefulness judgment additionally requires a relevant adjudicated finding with a demonstrated decision consequence.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.LIMITS: Neither a finding nor better detection automatically establishes acceptance, full need fulfillment or net workflow benefit; the proposed subjudgments are not an empirically validated acceptance algorithm.

EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Scenario versus checklist/ad hoc detection, with separate meeting outcomes.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.SUPPORT: S026 reports higher detection for fault-specific scenarios within two runs using the same study program/materials. S027 is adjacent evidence about linguistic quality and domain modeling, not this inspection effect.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.LIMITS: A local useful finding alone cannot support comparative detection or net-effect PASS. Net benefit needs relevant comparison, total effort/correction burden and a stated decision criterion; qualitative justification remains qualitative.

DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Choosing a review procedure for a specified risk and claimed benefit.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.SUPPORT: S026 can inform the detection comparison under its conditions. The revised P01 separately assesses local discovery, comparative detection and net workflow benefit so the evidence matches the decision.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.LIMITS: No universal optimum or cost-effectiveness threshold follows. Comparator adequacy, fault relevance and material costs require contextual assessment; criterion design is not measured causal effectiveness.

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.EVIDENCE_CEILING: S026 supports bounded detection comparisons in two runs with 48 graduate students and two event-driven SRSs. Its within-program replication does not validate this operational rule or establish total net benefit in another workflow. LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING is observational; comparative and net-effect judgments require their respective evidence. S027 is adjacent linguistic-quality/domain-modeling evidence, not inspection-method replication.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Inspection scenario means a fault-focused reading procedure, not a behavioral use case or BDD example. Unknown faults, domain misunderstandings and representational blind spots remain.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Replicate the targeted comparison with relevant practitioners/artifacts and include cost, false positives and unanticipated defects.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Replicate the targeted comparison with relevant practitioners/artifacts and include cost, false positives and unanticipated defects.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: The reviewers inspected the complete claim/disposition population and selected detailed semantics/source bodies. Absence of an individual finding does not establish independent validation of every field, source or proposed predicate.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONTEXT: inspect equivalent existing mechanism, guard, cheap path and evidence before considering any adoption
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: Which subclaim is needed here: a local useful finding, comparative detection effect or net workflow benefit, and what matching evidence supports it?
Does a simpler existing mechanism answer the same consumer question, and is any practical cost justification explicitly qualitative where no measured net effect is established?
Which artifact, reviewer, fault-class or task change would invalidate transfer and require re-entry?
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: All scenario-based reviews or any checklist are proven superior in every domain.
No finding about any target repository or semantic owner is supplied.

SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.INPUT: Specification/version, risk/fault taxonomy, reading procedure, reviewer background, findings and adjudication.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.OUTPUT: Where known fault classes and a suitable specification exist, use concrete reading procedures targeted at those faults, with locally validated cost and detection value.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.CONSUMER: Review organizer choosing an inspection technique for a known risk.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.BOUNDARY: Inspection scenario means a fault-focused reading procedure, not a behavioral use case or BDD example.

VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.APPLICATION: Target-neutral schema applied to the property; worked cases are explicitly analytical
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.CLAIM: Where known fault classes and a suitable specification exist, use concrete reading procedures targeted at those faults, with locally validated cost and detection value.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.CRITERION: Declare the assessed subclaim, artifact/version, fault class, reading procedure, reviewer scope and adjudicated results. LOCAL_USEFUL_FINDING is a bounded observational subjudgment: an actual relevant, adjudicated finding with a demonstrated decision consequence may PASS without a comparator; this does not grant P01 an empirical-effect PASS. COMPARATIVE_DETECTION_EFFECT may PASS only when an appropriate comparison supports the stated detection effect for the named artifact/task/reviewer scope with uncertainty and design limits recorded. NET_WORKFLOW_BENEFIT may PASS only when relevant comparative outcomes, setup/training/review effort, false positives, adjudication/correction burden and other material costs support the declared decision criterion. P01 retains EMPIRICAL_REGULARITY_HYPOTHESIS: its PASS is scoped to the supported comparative or net-effect subclaim, and cannot be obtained from a local useful finding alone. If required comparison or cost evidence is absent, the asserted stronger effect is UNKNOWN; an unrequested subclaim may be explicitly NOT_ASSESSED without a favorable verdict. A qualitative practical cost justification can support a bounded choice of review stage, but must be labeled qualitative and cannot be reported as a measured comparative or causal net effect. A completed checklist without a relevant search supplies no finding evidence; efficacy outside the supported scope remains UNKNOWN.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.SUBJECT_CONFIGURATION: A requirements review and specified fault classes
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.METHOD: Assign a reading procedure that guides the reviewer through representations/checks relevant to a fault, rather than merely naming a general quality.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.EVALUATOR: Named competent reviewer for the criterion; independence and shared priors disclosed
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.OBSERVER: Person/tool that actually observes the relevant behavior or task result
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.ENVIRONMENT: Inspection scenario means a fault-focused reading procedure, not a behavioral use case or BDD example.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.NEGATIVE_CONTROLS: An expensive procedure finds an adjudicated omission that a cheaper adequate review also finds. Local usefulness can hold while comparative advantage or net benefit is unsupported or fails the declared criterion. Checklist completion without an actual relevant search supplies no local-finding evidence.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.EVIDENCE: For local usefulness, retain the finding, adjudication and demonstrated decision change. For a comparative effect, add suitable comparator records, relevant detection outcomes and uncertainty. For net benefit, also retain setup/training/review effort, false positives, adjudication/correction and other material costs under the declared criterion.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.RECEIVING_AUTHORITY: Fault discovery informs a decision but does not itself settle stakeholder preference or authority.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.REMAINING_LIMITS: Unknown faults, domain misunderstandings and representational blind spots remain. Local usefulness does not settle comparative detection or net benefit; qualitative practical justification is not a measured causal effect.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Candidate universal claim: adding a collection meeting after individual review necessarily increases net relevant defect detection enough to justify the burden.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: An additional review meeting and its incremental effect
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Repeated review ceremonies are justified by assumed inevitable quality gain.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: The rejected inference treats attendance/repetition as detection evidence without distinguishing new findings, lost findings and decisions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Separate functions and retain only the unresolved function and observed/context-supported value.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: In the1995 study, meeting gains did not provide a net improvement over individual discovery; this is a bounded counterexample to necessity, not proof that meetings never help.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Asynchronous reconciliation of already known findings or a meeting aimed at a specific unresolved interpretation.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Necessity would require positive net detection in every applicable situation, a claim defeated by a bounded counterexample.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Collection/detection function only; negotiation, learning, shared interpretation and authority decisions may independently justify a meeting.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Collection/detection function only; negotiation, learning, shared interpretation and authority decisions may independently justify a meeting. Excludes any target repository finding or inter-lineage ownership assignment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: A meeting can be needed to exercise a real decision right; that is separate from guaranteed defect-detection gain.

Positive net findings supports only that meeting/context. Missing before/after records yields UNKNOWN; meetings justified by another function are INAPPLICABLE to this detection claim.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Before/after finding sets, independent adjudication and effort.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Individual findings before meeting, new findings, dismissed/lost findings, adjudication and time.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: An informed evaluator checks applicability, identifies the exact claim and scope, reviews the named witnesses, tests the supplied counterexample class and records a reasoned four-valued outcome. Mechanical schema checks can establish presence/identity, not domain truth or authority.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite record checks are mechanically decidable. Semantic correspondence, legitimate representation, proxy validity and causal transfer generally require contextual judgment and may remain UNKNOWN. No claim of general decidability.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.TEXT: A meeting addresses an unresolved contradictory interpretation and finds a new release-critical defect; its value is shown locally.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.TEXT: A collection meeting adds as many valid defects as it discards, with additional participant time; necessity of positive net detection is false.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: The guard plausibly applies but required source, semantic interpretation, authority, context or observation is missing/disputed; insufficient evidence is not silently coded FAIL or PASS.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A duly authorized stakeholder negotiation is needed to choose between incompatible interests, regardless of defect count.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: Repetition is not additional evidence.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: Rejecting a legitimate cheap path, demanding irrelevant evidence, or treating an unrecorded but unresolved dimension as known false.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An empty declared scope cannot pass merely because no obligations were listed: explain why the guard is inapplicable or why the scope is adequate. Repetition is not additional evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Change in meeting purpose, participant knowledge or unresolved questions changes applicability.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Reviewer coordination and preparation plus potential suppression of valid individual findings. Alternative: If evidence and dispositions already settle the decision, complete the decision without another detection ceremony.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: In the1995 study, meeting gains did not provide a net improvement over individual discovery; this is a bounded counterexample to necessity, not proof that meetings never help. The operational rule is a proposed audit discriminator, not a measured process-effect claim.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: Analytical operational reconstruction from inspected primary sources; no claim of a source-native theorem or universal algorithm.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: For the detection-only necessity claim, nonpositive net relevant findings with positive cost is a FAIL counterexample. Positive net findings supports only that meeting/context. Missing before/after records yields UNKNOWN; meetings justified by another function are INAPPLICABLE to this detection claim.

OUTCOMES.PASS: Required evidence supports the bounded claim within scope; no universal extrapolation
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An applicable observed contradiction, failed criterion or valid counterexample defeats the specified claim
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Relevant evidence/meaning/authority is missing, disputed or not discriminating
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: An explicit guard excludes the claim; cheap path must be justified

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.EMPTY_SCOPE_RULE: Empty obligation/source sets never establish completeness by vacuity; show scope adequacy or label inapplicable/unknown.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: A meeting addresses an unresolved contradictory interpretation and finds a new release-critical defect; its value is shown locally.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE: A collection meeting adds as many valid defects as it discards, with additional participant time; necessity of positive net detection is false.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE: A duly authorized stakeholder negotiation is needed to choose between incompatible interests, regardless of defect count.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: Before/after finding sets, independent adjudication and effort. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN unless an explicit contradicted claim is being tested.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Change in meeting purpose, participant knowledge or unresolved questions changes applicability.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Calling meetings waste from one experiment would overgeneralize just as much as requiring them universally.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: A collection meeting adds as many valid defects as it discards, with additional participant time; necessity of positive net detection is false.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Separate functions and retain only the unresolved function and observed/context-supported value.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Reject mandatory detection ceremony; preserve purposeful collective decisions.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Some benefits are difficult to quantify and require an explicit qualitative rationale.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: Repetition is not additional evidence.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retain the rejection in the denominator, not an adoption candidate. Separate functions and retain only the unresolved function and observed/context-supported value.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Fault-specific scenario reading outperformed checklist/ad hoc under study conditions; meetings did not add net detection benefit
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: DIRECT_MEETING_DETECTION_SUBANALYSIS in the same replicated inspection experiment as C0114; not independent study
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION: 48 graduate students, two small event-driven SRSs and constrained crossover; not all industrial reviews or negotiation; naturally occurring faults rather than deliberately seeded faults

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.LOCATOR: pp. 22–24, 29–31; inquiry cycle and level-of-effort discussion
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM_SUPPORTED: Questions, answers, reasons and changes can elaborate requirements; scenarios have particular-situation scope; shortcuts allowed
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: ADJACENT_CONCEPTUAL_INQUIRY_MECHANISM distinguishing interpretation from collection; no meeting-effect comparison
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION: Meeting-scheduler exercise and rough effort extrapolation, not controlled industrial payoff; downstream rationale use not studied

CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM_CHALLENGED: All meetings are useless, or every additional review increases assurance.
CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.QUALIFICATION: 48 graduate students, two small event-driven SRSs and constrained crossover; not all industrial reviews or negotiation; naturally occurring faults rather than deliberately seeded faults

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITS: Origin means inspected antecedent, not an assertion of absolute first invention

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.SUPPORT: Named language definitions and explicit counterexamples where applicable; no general effectiveness theorem
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITS: The four-valued rule is an operational reconstruction; authority and world correspondence are not logically supplied by syntax

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.SUPPORT: S026 compares individual discoveries with meeting reports and finds meeting gains offset by losses in its studied setting. This supplies bounded counterevidence to necessarily improved detection from collection meetings.
EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITS: The result is a subanalysis of the same 48-student/two-artifact inspection experiment supporting C0114, not independent evidence. It does not measure every meeting function or prove that all meetings lack net value.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.SUPPORT: The two S026 study runs also measure individual discoveries, meeting gains and meeting losses; the reported net detection result challenges inevitable benefit from another collection meeting.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.LIMITS: This is the same experiment and data as the C0114 reading-method comparison, not an independent evidence source. It does not establish that meetings with negotiation, authority or learning functions lack value.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.ORIGINAL_OR_REPLICATED_CLAIM: The tested meeting subclaim concerns net detection added by collection after individual review. The study finds gains offset by losses in its setting.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.POPULATION_TASK_AND_OUTCOME: 48 graduate reviewers in two runs, 16 teams, two event-driven SRSs; team reports are compared with individual findings to identify gained and lost faults.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.DEPENDENCE: The runs share investigators, artifacts, fault classification and study design. S026 mentions earlier meeting research, but its underlying data are not independently inspected here and are not counted as an additional replication.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.TRANSFER_TO_RETAINED_PROPERTY: A bounded counterexample to detection necessity; no estimate of universal meeting cost/benefit or empirical validation of the asynchronous replacement policy.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.SUPPORT: Qualitative practitioner cases or source-document rewrite; distinctions in source records apply
INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.LIMITS: Reported practices and perceptions are not randomized process benefits or universal prevalence

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.SUPPORT: Calling meetings waste from one experiment would overgeneralize just as much as requiring them universally.
NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.LIMITS: A paper’s open problem is not an observed failure; the constructed cases are not incident reports

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.SUPPORT: No external standard mandate asserted in this research sublane
STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.LIMITS: Language conventions and an author’s chosen criterion do not grant normative authority; cited ISO editions not independently adopted

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.SUPPORT: Before/after finding sets, independent adjudication and effort.
PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: A tool’s existence/performance on selected examples does not establish organizational success

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.SUPPORT: A meeting addresses an unresolved contradictory interpretation and finds a new release-critical defect; its value is shown locally.
TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.LIMITS: Constructed examples expose distinctions; they are not evidence of implementation effectiveness in a target repository

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.SUPPORT: Some benefits are difficult to quantify and require an explicit qualitative rationale.
CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: Contrary findings narrow claims; they do not justify symmetric overgeneralization

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.SUPPORT: Necessity would require positive net detection in every applicable situation, a claim defeated by a bounded counterexample.
ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.LIMITS: Change in meeting purpose, participant knowledge or unresolved questions changes applicability.

DOMAIN_VALIDITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Necessary additional detection from collection meetings after individual inspection.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.SUPPORT: S026 measures meeting gains and losses on two event-driven specifications and finds no net detection improvement in the studied setting. This contradicts the necessity claim within its stated detection scope.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.LIMITS: It does not establish that all meetings are useless or harmful; negotiation, interpretation, authorization and learning are different functions.

STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Whose findings and losses enter the meeting comparison.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.SUPPORT: The same 48 graduate reviewers and 16 teams in S026 supply the individual and collection-meeting records.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.LIMITS: No representative practitioner or affected-stakeholder sample is established; counting reviewers does not measure agreement, authority or learning value.

NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Whether a detection-only result removes a required approval or negotiation step.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.SUPPORT: This record rejects inevitable empirical detection benefit, not an independently authorized meeting obligation.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.LIMITS: No applicable contractual or organizational mandate is assessed, and a nonpositive detection result cannot alone cancel one.

REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Formal correctness from adding or removing a meeting.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.SUPPORT: The claim concerns marginal detection outcomes, not a mathematical refinement relation.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.LIMITS: Neither another review nor omission of a redundant meeting supplies a refinement proof.

REALIZABILITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Implementation feasibility inferred from meeting activity.
REALIZABILITY.SUPPORT: The meeting comparison concerns inspection records on existing specifications. It does not establish realizability of those requirements.
REALIZABILITY.LIMITS: Changing the meeting policy cannot by itself resolve technical or environmental infeasibility.

TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Correspondence between individual discoveries and final meeting reports.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.SUPPORT: S026 explicitly distinguishes newly identified faults from individual faults missing in the team report, allowing gains and losses to be evaluated separately.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.LIMITS: The study does not validate lifecycle trace maintenance or measure all reasons a finding is suppressed or reinterpreted.

ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Detection-only necessity versus other meeting purposes.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.SUPPORT: S026 supports the detection comparison; S017 supplies a distinct inquiry/rationale mechanism through questions and answers. Their separation prevents a detection verdict from deciding an unresolved interpretation or authority issue.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.LIMITS: The inquiry example is not a comparative validation of meeting effectiveness, and neither source establishes that a specified acceptance decision is legitimate.

LOCATORS.LOCATOR: pp. 22–24, 29–31; inquiry cycle and level-of-effort discussion

EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Incremental net detection in the two S026 study runs.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.SUPPORT: Meeting gains were offset by losses in this experiment, challenging the assertion that another collection meeting necessarily improves detection.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.LIMITS: Detection counts are not a complete valuation of meetings. This result is not an independent empirical demonstration of the proposed asynchronous alternative or of total cost savings in every context.

DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.WHAT_WAS_EXAMINED: Whether another review stage serves an unresolved function worth its burden.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.SUPPORT: Separating individual discoveries, meeting gains and losses exposes a valid failure mode for the universal detection claim. S017 helps distinguish inquiry from redundant collection.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.LIMITS: No optimal meeting policy is estimated; costs and non-detection benefits may require a reasoned qualitative decision rather than a claimed measured causal gain.

LOCATORS.LOCATOR: pp. 22–24, 29–31; inquiry cycle and level-of-effort discussion

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.EVIDENCE_CEILING: In the1995 study, meeting gains did not provide a net improvement over individual discovery; this is a bounded counterexample to necessity, not proof that meetings never help. Source access levels bind every claim; schema completeness is not domain validation.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Collection/detection function only; negotiation, learning, shared interpretation and authority decisions may independently justify a meeting. Some benefits are difficult to quantify and require an explicit qualitative rationale.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Specify the extra meeting’s unresolved question and check its incremental decision value, not attendance.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Specify the extra meeting’s unresolved question and check its incremental decision value, not attendance.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: The reviewers inspected the complete claim/disposition population and selected detailed semantics/source bodies. Absence of an individual finding does not establish independent validation of every field, source or proposed predicate.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: NOT_A_GENERAL_ADOPTION_CANDIDATE: rejected/ceremonial sufficiency claim; use as an overclaim discriminator
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: What uncertainty or authority decision can this meeting resolve that existing evidence cannot?
Does a simpler existing mechanism already answer the same consumer question?
Which assumption, scope or authority change would require re-entry?
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: All meetings are useless, or every additional review increases assurance.
No finding about any target repository or semantic owner is supplied.

SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.OUTPUT: Candidate universal claim: adding a collection meeting after individual review necessarily increases net relevant defect detection enough to justify the burden.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.CONSUMER: Review organizer deciding whether another meeting is necessary.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES.BOUNDARY: Collection/detection function only; negotiation, learning, shared interpretation and authority decisions may independently justify a meeting.

VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.CLAIM: Candidate universal claim: adding a collection meeting after individual review necessarily increases net relevant defect detection enough to justify the burden.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.CRITERION: For the detection-only necessity claim, nonpositive net relevant findings with positive cost is a FAIL counterexample. Positive net findings supports only that meeting/context. Missing before/after records yields UNKNOWN; meetings justified by another function are INAPPLICABLE to this detection claim.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.SUBJECT_CONFIGURATION: An additional review meeting and its incremental effect
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.METHOD: The rejected inference treats attendance/repetition as detection evidence without distinguishing new findings, lost findings and decisions.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.EVALUATOR: Named competent reviewer for the criterion; independence and shared priors disclosed
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.OBSERVER: Person/tool that actually observes the relevant behavior or task result
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.ENVIRONMENT: Collection/detection function only; negotiation, learning, shared interpretation and authority decisions may independently justify a meeting.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.NEGATIVE_CONTROLS: A collection meeting adds as many valid defects as it discards, with additional participant time; necessity of positive net detection is false.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.EVIDENCE: Before/after finding sets, independent adjudication and effort.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.RECEIVING_AUTHORITY: A meeting can be needed to exercise a real decision right; that is separate from guaranteed defect-detection gain.
VALIDATION_ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE.REMAINING_LIMITS: Some benefits are difficult to quantify and require an explicit qualitative rationale.
