GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: An authoritative-looking citation can import the wrong edition, a draft, an irrelevant clause or a voluntary recommendation as a binding obligation.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.

LOCATORS: Edition; publication date; lifecycle stage; abstract
Active PAR; approval date; revision/supersession target
Edition; publication date; previous edition status

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. Standards/lifecycle frameworks provide stable shared vocabulary and obligations when adopted; their revisions and draft statuses introduce separate applicability questions.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A normative requirement is applicable only through an identified source/version/status, relevant subject and context, and a valid adoption authority; conformity claims must stop at what the inspected text and evidence establish.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A claimed obligation on a system, process or organization in a specified context.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: An authoritative-looking citation can import the wrong edition, a draft, an irrelevant clause or a voluntary recommendation as a binding obligation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Trace each obligation through source status, adoption basis, applicability conditions, exceptions and conflicting authorities; distinguish discovery metadata from inspected clauses.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Maintain an applicability record and change watch tied to the adopted edition; a newer publication can trigger review without silently rewriting a dated contractual commitment.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids both obsolete compliance claims and indiscriminate adoption of draft or irrelevant demands.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Official records resolve status; no empirical claim that filling an applicability table improves outcomes is established.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A claimed obligation on a system, process or organization in a specified context.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For an internal preference with no external authority claim, record the responsible stakeholder and decision; no standards crosswalk is needed.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A requirement is justified as standard-, policy-, law- or contract-derived, or an external conformance claim is made.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For an internal preference with no external authority claim, record the responsible stakeholder and decision; no standards crosswalk is needed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Relevant source text is accessible for any clause-level interpretation; responsible authority can resolve context and exceptions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: This record establishes applicability and provenance, not substantive legal advice or whole-domain compliance.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: This record establishes applicability and provenance, not substantive legal advice or whole-domain compliance. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: 29148:2026 is final; SSDF1.2 is final; all published standards are binding; conformity proves safety.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: ISO metadata alone is not adoption. W3C Recommendation, NIST voluntary guidance, DIS and IEEE PAR are different authority/status types.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Exact title/edition/date/status, clause if actually read, authoritative locator, adopted version, applicable subject, exception/conflict decision and evidence of conformity.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Unavailable normative text means clause interpretation remains UNKNOWN; status metadata can still be reported honestly.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Version monitoring and context interpretation; avoid copying every clause when only a narrow subject is in scope.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: When adoption ends or subject leaves scope; re-enter on publication, contract/jurisdiction/context change or newly discovered conflicting authority.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.INTENDED_MEANING: PUBLISHED_STANDARD, RECOMMENDATION, DRAFT, PROJECT, CONTRACT, POLICY or PREFERENCE with exact version
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: A claimed obligation on a system, process or organization in a specified context.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.UNIT_OR_SCALE: Categorical/relational record; time/physical units are declared in the underlying domain requirement rather than invented here.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.ALLOWED_VALUES_OR_CONSTRAINTS: Versioned known value with provenance, explicit UNKNOWN with reason, or NOT_APPLICABLE with guard rationale; no silent empty-as-pass convention.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.OBSERVED_DERIVED_ASSUMED_OR_STIPULATED: Schema is researcher-proposed; actual instance values must distinguish observed records, derived judgments, assumptions and authorized stipulations.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MEASUREMENT_OR_DERIVATION_METHOD: Inspect primary issuing-body record and adoption document

SOURCE_OR_WITNESS.WITNESS: Observed currentness case: ISO29148 edition2:2018 is published while edition3 is DIS in September2026; record both without inventing a final2026 edition.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.RESOLUTION_AND_UNCERTAINTY: No published edition inferred from a paper citation or DOI year
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MISSING_UNKNOWN_NOT_APPLICABLE_DISTINCTI: MISSING means no value supplied; UNKNOWN means investigated but unresolved; NOT_APPLICABLE requires the stated guard to be false. Neither is a favorable judgment.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.VALID_TIME_OR_VERSION: Valid at the cutoff/adoption date; later revisions trigger review, not automatic retroactive replacement.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.CHANGE_IMPACT: Source correction/status, adoption instrument, subject/context, exception or authority changes.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: A claimed obligation on a system, process or organization in a specified context.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.UNIT_OR_SCALE: Categorical/relational record; time/physical units are declared in the underlying domain requirement rather than invented here.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.ALLOWED_VALUES_OR_CONSTRAINTS: Versioned known value with provenance, explicit UNKNOWN with reason, or NOT_APPLICABLE with guard rationale; no silent empty-as-pass convention.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MEASUREMENT_OR_DERIVATION_METHOD: Compare inspected normative scope with adopted subject and decision authority

SOURCE_OR_WITNESS.WITNESS: Observed currentness case: ISO29148 edition2:2018 is published while edition3 is DIS in September2026; record both without inventing a final2026 edition.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.RESOLUTION_AND_UNCERTAINTY: Unknown clause text or context is not a negative finding
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MISSING_UNKNOWN_NOT_APPLICABLE_DISTINCTI: MISSING means no value supplied; UNKNOWN means investigated but unresolved; NOT_APPLICABLE requires the stated guard to be false. Neither is a favorable judgment.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.VALID_TIME_OR_VERSION: Valid at the cutoff/adoption date; later revisions trigger review, not automatic retroactive replacement.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.CHANGE_IMPACT: Source correction/status, adoption instrument, subject/context, exception or authority changes.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Versioned and scoped normative applicability
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Obligation o × source/version s × subject x × context c × adoption authority a
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Obligation o × source/version s × subject x × context c × adoption authority a. Identifiers refer to versioned real artifacts/actors; context predicates require their own domain units. No arithmetic over arbitrary category codes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every material applicable instance in the explicitly declared set; an empty set is NOT_APPLICABLE or vacuous, not evidence of universal success. This record establishes applicability and provenance, not substantive legal advice or whole-domain compliance.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A claimed obligation on a system, process or organization in a specified context.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Valid at the cutoff/adoption date; later revisions trigger review, not automatic retroactive replacement.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Relevant source text is accessible for any clause-level interpretation; responsible authority can resolve context and exceptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A requirement is justified as standard-, policy-, law- or contract-derived, or an external conformance claim is made.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For each asserted obligation o, require an identified issuing source/version/status, accessible text supporting the asserted scope, an adoption/authority path and a resolved applicability guard. If text is unavailable, permit a metadata-only status claim but return UNKNOWN for clause-level conformity. Draft recommendations remain drafts even when cited without DIS.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Official publication status plus the actual adoption instrument and scoped conformance evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Exact title/edition/date/status, clause if actually read, authoritative locator, adopted version, applicable subject, exception/conflict decision and evidence of conformity.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Authority-aware human interpretation, assisted by mechanical edition/status checks.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Edition/status lookup is bounded; jurisdiction, contract conflict and semantic applicability may require specialist judgment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Observed currentness case: ISO29148 edition2:2018 is published while edition3 is DIS in September2026; record both without inventing a final2026 edition.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed example: cite WCAG3 Working Draft as mandatory replacement for WCAG2.2 and assert universal accessibility.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Full clause unavailable, adopted edition unspecified, or competing authorities unresolved.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A team preference for a default font is attributed to the product owner without claiming a standards mandate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from a valid standard attached to an inapplicable subject; false failure from assuming latest edition automatically overrides a dated adoption.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Claim conformance after selecting only easy clauses or excluding the material subject without authority.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Source correction/status, adoption instrument, subject/context, exception or authority changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Version monitoring and context interpretation; avoid copying every clause when only a narrow subject is in scope. For an internal preference with no external authority claim, record the responsible stakeholder and decision; no standards crosswalk is needed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Official records resolve status; no empirical claim that filling an applicability table improves outcomes is established. Paid standards clauses and full jurisdictional legal analysis remain outside the inspected evidence.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.PROCEDURE: Authority-aware human interpretation, assisted by mechanical edition/status checks.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.OUTCOME_SEMANTICS: PASS means the precisely stated rule is met under its assumptions; FAIL means an observed/model/rule violation, UNKNOWN means insufficient evidence, NOT_APPLICABLE means guard false. For rejected candidates, the diagnostic classifies the overclaim as unsupported rather than proving every instance false.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.LIMIT: Edition/status lookup is bounded; jurisdiction, contract conflict and semantic applicability may require specialist judgment.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: Observed currentness case: ISO29148 edition2:2018 is published while edition3 is DIS in September2026; record both without inventing a final2026 edition.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Constructed example: cite WCAG3 Working Draft as mandatory replacement for WCAG2.2 and assert universal accessibility.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE: A team preference for a default font is attributed to the product owner without claiming a standards mandate.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: Official publication status plus the actual adoption instrument and scoped conformance evidence. Full clause unavailable, adopted edition unspecified, or competing authorities unresolved.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Source correction/status, adoption instrument, subject/context, exception or authority changes.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Standards mapping can become expensive paperwork and confuse conformity with mission success.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Constructed example: cite WCAG3 Working Draft as mandatory replacement for WCAG2.2 and assert universal accessibility. Claim conformance after selecting only easy clauses or excluding the material subject without authority.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Retain the authority path and specific evidence; avoid universal process import and separately assess outcomes.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Stable external constraints remain legitimate; the applicability record does not prove the controlled harm is absent.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Paid standards clauses and full jurisdictional legal analysis remain outside the inspected evidence.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: A standards logo, bibliography entry or signed checklist is not the applicability mechanism.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retained only for its named bearer/trigger with the listed evidence ceiling and cheaper alternative. Retain the authority path and specific evidence; avoid universal process import and separately assess outcomes.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Standards/lifecycle frameworks provide stable shared vocabulary and obligations when adopted; their revisions and draft statuses introduce separate applicability questions.
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITATIONS: Chronology is not by itself direct influence; genealogy edges separately distinguish documented relations from analogy.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: The principal claim is an empirical, institutional or qualitative judgment, not a theorem.
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: Edition/status lookup is bounded; jurisdiction, contract conflict and semantic applicability may require specialist judgment.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Official records resolve status; no empirical claim that filling an applicability table improves outcomes is established.
EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: No comparison directly validates every clause of this researcher-proposed operational record; source-specific designs and baselines remain limiting.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of this entire reconstructed property was identified in the inspected bounded corpus.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.LIMITATIONS: Artifacts, repeated model runs and multiple publications on one dataset are not independent replications.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: No industrial field outcome is asserted by this source-based/representation claim.
INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.LIMITATIONS: This record establishes applicability and provenance, not substantive legal advice or whole-domain compliance.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: No direct field counterexample to the bounded reconstructed claim was located; constructed witnesses test its intended meaning.
NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.LIMITATIONS: A source limitation or constructed example is not an observed incident. Negative direction and statistical certainty remain separate.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: ISO metadata alone is not adoption. W3C Recommendation, NIST voluntary guidance, DIS and IEEE PAR are different authority/status types.
STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.LIMITATIONS: Official status and public text support only inspected provisions; adoption/application is separate.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Official records resolve status; no empirical claim that filling an applicability table improves outcomes is established.
PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.LIMITATIONS: Tool/method descriptions establish available mechanisms; reports of perceived usefulness are not measured task-outcome effects.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Maintain an applicability record and change watch tied to the adopted edition; a newer publication can trigger review without silently rewriting a dated contractual commitment.
TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.LIMITATIONS: This record establishes applicability and provenance, not substantive legal advice or whole-domain compliance. Paid standards clauses and full jurisdictional legal analysis remain outside the inspected evidence.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Standards mapping can become expensive paperwork and confuse conformity with mission success.
CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.LIMITATIONS: This is the strongest reviewed objection/limit, not a claim that every cited source rejects the retained bounded form.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Relevant source text is accessible for any clause-level interpretation; responsible authority can resolve context and exceptions.
ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.LIMITATIONS: Unavailable normative text means clause interpretation remains UNKNOWN; status metadata can still be reported honestly.

DOMAIN_VALIDITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Official records support the status and scope of named documents. They do not establish how an unseen system, jurisdiction or contract falls within those documents.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
DOMAIN_VALIDITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: A normative publication may define beneficiaries or scope, but this record does not establish coverage of all stakeholders in a future application.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
STAKEHOLDER_COVERAGE.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Official publication and draft status are supported at the inspected scope. Unread paid clauses and actual adoption/jurisdiction remain unresolved; uncertainty establishes neither binding force nor optionality.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Edition and adoption comparison is not a formal goal-refinement theorem. New wording must be interpreted at the relevant clause and version.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

REALIZABILITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: A binding requirement can be infeasible in a proposed design. Document status provides no implementation strategy or technical feasibility proof.
REALIZABILITY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
REALIZABILITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Exact edition and clause references can be checked where text is available. Bibliographic identity is not evidence that a requirement-to-clause interpretation is semantically correct.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Conformance and acceptance are separately scoped judgments. A document's official status does not prove an implementation conforms or that conformity meets every need.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: These official sources establish normative or guidance content, not a comparative effect of filling an applicability register.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: The current/reduced decision model can expose unresolved obligations explicitly. Removing an obligation requires demonstrated non-applicability, not missing access or a failed search.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

EVIDENCE_CEILING.STRONGEST_SUPPORTED_CLAIM: Official records resolve status; no empirical claim that filling an applicability table improves outcomes is established.
EVIDENCE_CEILING.STRONGER_UNSUPPORTED_CLAIMS: 29148:2026 is final; SSDF1.2 is final; all published standards are binding; conformity proves safety.

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: This record establishes applicability and provenance, not substantive legal advice or whole-domain compliance. Paid standards clauses and full jurisdictional legal analysis remain outside the inspected evidence.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Full clause unavailable, adopted edition unspecified, or competing authorities unresolved. Paid standards clauses and full jurisdictional legal analysis remain outside the inspected evidence.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Obtain the actual adopted normative text for any downstream clause-level claim, then test applicability against real subject and exceptions.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: The reviewers inspected the complete claim/disposition population and selected detailed semantics/source bodies. Absence of an individual finding does not establish independent validation of every field, source or proposed predicate.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: ELIGIBLE_AS_CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE; apply only after independent target/context/authority analysis, not automatically.
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: Which edition/status and clause support this claim?
What makes it applicable here?
Which parts of the source were actually inspected?
INTAKE.PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: 29148:2026 is final; SSDF1.2 is final; all published standards are binding; conformity proves safety.

NORMATIVE_APPLICABILITY_PROFILE.SOURCE: Primary issuing body plus adoption instrument.
NORMATIVE_APPLICABILITY_PROFILE.VERSION: Exact edition and amendment, separately from access date.
NORMATIVE_APPLICABILITY_PROFILE.APPLICABLE_SUBJECT_CONTEXT: Named system/process, deployment and lifecycle stage.
NORMATIVE_APPLICABILITY_PROFILE.EXCEPTIONS: Authorized exceptions with rationale and duration.
NORMATIVE_APPLICABILITY_PROFILE.CONFLICTS: Identify conflicting obligations and resolution authority.
NORMATIVE_APPLICABILITY_PROFILE.RESPONSIBLE_AUTHORITY: Issuer differs from adopter and assessor.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Hazard-context-linked control constraints

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: STPA Handbook2018 operationalizes system-theoretic safety analysis into unsafe control actions and contextual constraints; the contribution here is the requirements interface, not ownership of safety engineering.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Unsafe control action; controller constraint; loss scenario
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A generic safe-system statement or component check can omit the context in which a control action produces loss.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. STPA Handbook2018 operationalizes system-theoretic safety analysis into unsafe control actions and contextual constraints; the contribution here is the requirements interface, not ownership of safety engineering.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A safety-related control requirement needs a trace to an identified loss/hazard, the action and actual hazardous context, and assumptions about control/feedback that make the constraint relevant.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A control constraint and its hazardous-context justification.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A generic safe-system statement or component check can omit the context in which a control action produces loss.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Examine unsafe provision, omission, timing/order and duration of actions; derive constraints and scenarios that expose process-model, feedback and coordination assumptions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Keep context and assumptions with the constraint, and re-evaluate them when control structure, environment or allocation changes.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Makes dangerous interactions discussable and gives acceptance/assurance work a concrete subject.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: N020 is a method handbook with worked examples; N042 illustrates that specified interfaces can fail in implementation/coordination; N028 warns that monitors themselves have costs. No universal comparative accident reduction inferred.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A control constraint and its hazardous-context justification.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For a reversible cosmetic change with no plausible connection to the relevant hazards, record a bounded impact rationale; do not repeat the entire safety analysis.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A proposed behavior or control interaction could contribute to a specified loss.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a reversible cosmetic change with no plausible connection to the relevant hazards, record a bounded impact rationale; do not repeat the entire safety analysis.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Losses/hazards and control structure are sufficiently understood; hazard-context predicates describe actual conditions, not merely controller belief.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Identified hazards/control interactions within an operating envelope; no complete safety case or certification claimed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Identified hazards/control interactions within an operating envelope; no complete safety case or certification claimed. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: All four control-action categories were filled, therefore every hazard is controlled.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: STPA is an analysis method; binding constraints require the relevant mission/domain decision or adopted obligation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Loss/hazard IDs, unsafe action/context, controller/process model, feedback assumptions, derived requirement and evidence plan.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Unknown context or unreliable feedback can make a nominally correct controller unsafe; unresolved hazards remain explicit.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Expert elicitation and maintaining context as architecture evolves; exhaustive-looking tables can grow without useful analysis.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Retire when the hazard/control path is removed with evidence; re-enter on operating-mode, environment, feedback or responsibility changes.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Hazard-context-linked control constraints
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Control constraint k × hazard h × domain context c × control/feedback model M
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Control constraint k × hazard h × domain context c × control/feedback model M. Identifiers refer to versioned real artifacts/actors; context predicates require their own domain units. No arithmetic over arbitrary category codes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every material applicable instance in the explicitly declared set; an empty set is NOT_APPLICABLE or vacuous, not evidence of universal success. Identified hazards/control interactions within an operating envelope; no complete safety case or certification claimed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A control constraint and its hazardous-context justification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: State and temporal ordering can determine hazard contribution; lifecycle changes reopen assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Losses/hazards and control structure are sufficiently understood; hazard-context predicates describe actual conditions, not merely controller belief.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A proposed behavior or control interaction could contribute to a specified loss.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For each admitted safety control constraint k, identify hazard h and actual context c; state the action/omission and timing relation k controls; identify the controller and relevant feedback assumptions; supply at least one hazardous witness and one safe/non-trigger contrast. PASS means the justification is inspectable, not that all hazards are eliminated.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Domain state, issued/omitted action, timing and feedback observed separately from controller’s internal belief.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Loss/hazard IDs, unsafe action/context, controller/process model, feedback assumptions, derived requirement and evidence plan.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Domain/scenario review; simulation or formal checking where model semantics support it.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite scenario/model checks possible; real-world completeness not decidable from a completed table.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed example: prohibit closing a barrier while a person occupies the protected zone; separately constrain sensing and response latency.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed example: a component passes its local command test while a stale occupancy sensor makes the command unsafe.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Hazard context, responsible controller or feedback latency cannot be established.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A help-page typo with no control or safety-information effect can use a brief impact decision.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from equating controller belief with actual state; false failure from analyzing an action without its context.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A requirement saying never be unsafe has no discriminating hazardous witness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed control structure, sensor/actuator semantics, environment, hazard or responsibility.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Expert elicitation and maintaining context as architecture evolves; exhaustive-looking tables can grow without useful analysis. For a reversible cosmetic change with no plausible connection to the relevant hazards, record a bounded impact rationale; do not repeat the entire safety analysis.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: N020 is a method handbook with worked examples; N042 illustrates that specified interfaces can fail in implementation/coordination; N028 warns that monitors themselves have costs. No universal comparative accident reduction inferred. Coverage of rare/unimagined interactions and quantified field benefit remain unsupported here.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.PROCEDURE: Domain/scenario review; simulation or formal checking where model semantics support it.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.OUTCOME_SEMANTICS: PASS means the precisely stated rule is met under its assumptions; FAIL means an observed/model/rule violation, UNKNOWN means insufficient evidence, NOT_APPLICABLE means guard false. For rejected candidates, the diagnostic classifies the overclaim as unsupported rather than proving every instance false.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.LIMIT: Finite scenario/model checks possible; real-world completeness not decidable from a completed table.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: Constructed example: prohibit closing a barrier while a person occupies the protected zone; separately constrain sensing and response latency.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Constructed example: a component passes its local command test while a stale occupancy sensor makes the command unsafe.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Safety analysis may look systematic while relying on incomplete models and analysts’ imagination.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Constructed example: a component passes its local command test while a stale occupancy sensor makes the command unsafe. A requirement saying never be unsafe has no discriminating hazardous witness.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Preserve assumptions, missing scenarios and residual hazards; use complementary evidence instead of treating categories as completeness proof.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: The analysis structures elicitation; it cannot supply missing domain knowledge or universal harm freedom.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Coverage of rare/unimagined interactions and quantified field benefit remain unsupported here.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: Counting unsafe-control-action rows or signing a hazard worksheet is not evidence of control effectiveness.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retained only for its named bearer/trigger with the listed evidence ceiling and cheaper alternative. Preserve assumptions, missing scenarios and residual hazards; use complementary evidence instead of treating categories as completeness proof.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ACCESS_CEILING: A structured hazard elicitation mechanism, not a proof that all real-world contexts or hazards have been captured. Bounded use here concerns derivation of requirements, not whole safety engineering.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Threat-grounded and maintainable security requirements

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: SQUARE2005 links security goals, artifacts, risk assessment, elicitation and prioritization; SSDF1.1 later recommends maintaining software security requirements.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Security goals; operational constraints; PO.1.2
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A security checklist can be complete as paperwork yet disconnected from assets, actors and the threat that motivates a control.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. SQUARE2005 links security goals, artifacts, risk assessment, elicitation and prioritization; SSDF1.1 later recommends maintaining software security requirements.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A security requirement should have an explicit asset/threat or adopted policy basis, a testable operational constraint, a responsible owner and a maintenance trigger.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A scoped security requirement and its threat/policy rationale.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A security checklist can be complete as paperwork yet disconnected from assets, actors and the threat that motivates a control.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Derive candidate constraints from goals and risk scenarios; prioritize and inspect their fit, then revise when threat, architecture or policy changes.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Risk-tailored elicitation with explicit exception decisions and feedback; no universal nine-step ceremony or fixed control list.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Separates a justified protection need from solution fashion and exposes gaps or trade-offs.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Privacy requirements over relationships and information use

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: LINDDUN2010/2011 explicitly translates STRIDE-compatible data-flow modeling into privacy threat analysis; its discussion identifies relational threats beyond local disclosure.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Linkability; identifiability; non-repudiation; detectability; disclosure; unawareness; noncompliance
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Confidentiality can hold while lawful-looking collection, linkage, inference or retention undermines privacy.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. LINDDUN2010/2011 explicitly translates STRIDE-compatible data-flow modeling into privacy threat analysis; its discussion identifies relational threats beyond local disclosure.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A privacy requirement must identify the people/data relationships and uses it constrains, including linkage or inferred information where material; a security control alone is insufficient evidence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A data relationship/use constraint across flows, stores, actors and time.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Confidentiality can hold while lawful-looking collection, linkage, inference or retention undermines privacy.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Model privacy-relevant assets and relationships, elicit threat paths, then derive scoped constraints or mitigations while preserving conflicts with accountability and utility.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Combine lightweight GO discovery or deeper DFD-based analysis with purpose/context and temporal inference review; do not equate a taxonomy pass with legal compliance.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Surfaces privacy harms that access-control-only requirements can miss.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: N018 establishes the method/representation argument and limitations; N019 documents available lower-cost methods. No comprehensive legal assurance or comparative field outcome established.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A data relationship/use constraint across flows, stores, actors and time.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For a genuinely nonpersonal static asset, record the basis for that scope; for a small personal-data feature, use a short relationship/use sketch and GO-style prompts before adopting a full model.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Personal or inferentially identifying data is collected, linked, inferred, retained, disclosed or used in a potentially harmful context.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a genuinely nonpersonal static asset, record the basis for that scope; for a small personal-data feature, use a short relationship/use sketch and GO-style prompts before adopting a full model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Important identities, relationships, recipients and inference possibilities are represented; social/legal context is reviewed by appropriate owners.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Privacy threat analysis within stated data and actors; not a complete interpretation of all privacy law.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Privacy threat analysis within stated data and actors; not a complete interpretation of all privacy law. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: Encrypted data is private; LINDDUN proves compliance with all privacy law.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Stakeholder privacy goals and applicable obligations require their own authority record; LINDDUN is a method.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Data items/subjects, sources, flows, purposes, recipients, retention and inference/linkage assumptions with justified mitigation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A DFD that omits cross-flow correlations or inferred information can pass local checks and still miss the privacy problem.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Keeping data maps/current purposes aligned; detailed modeling is costly and may expose sensitive information itself.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: When processing/retention ends and evidence supports removal; re-enter on new linkage, recipient, purpose or inference capability.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: A data relationship/use constraint across flows, stores, actors and time.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: The claimed process and supported technology configuration are identified; evaluators can inspect every applicable step.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A product or requirement asserts WCAG2.2 conformance or uses it as an adopted acceptance criterion.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For a WCAG2.2 claim at level L, apply §5.2.1–5.2.5: satisfy required criteria/alternatives for the claimed full pages, all pages in each complete process, accessibility-supported uses and non-interference. Missing evidence yields UNKNOWN. A pass is scoped conformance, not satisfaction of every accessibility need.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Operational paraphrase of WCAG2.2 §5.2.1–5.2.5 with researcher-added evidence/missingness handling; not a replacement normative text.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Criterion-specific user interaction/content evidence across all process steps.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Version/level, page/process inventory, technology/accessibility support, criterion results and unresolved steps.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Competent accessibility review with tools supporting only their covered criteria.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Some criteria admit mechanical checks; others need human/contextual evaluation. Process inventory completeness is a separate assumption.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed example: checkout is assessed through product selection, authentication, payment and confirmation with the declared support configuration.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed example: accessible product pages lead to an inaccessible payment dialog, while the site advertises complete checkout conformance.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Third-party payment/authentication step cannot be inspected or assistive-technology support assumptions are missing.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A rough concept sketch may receive limited accessibility feedback without making a conformance claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from automated-only scans; false failure from applying an inapplicable criterion without its guard.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Define the claimed process to exclude the only inaccessible step.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Content/flow/third-party component/support configuration or adopted version changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Manual and assistive-technology checks remain costly; automate only what the criterion and tool can actually assess. For an isolated prototype with no conformance claim, perform relevant keyboard/text/contrast checks and record limitations; no false complete-process certificate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: N021 is the normative basis itself; it establishes what the conformance claim means, not that conformity meets every user need. No universal user-need coverage or legal safe harbor follows.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: Operational paraphrase of WCAG2.2 §5.2.1–5.2.5 with researcher-added evidence/missingness handling; not a replacement normative text.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.PROCEDURE: Competent accessibility review with tools supporting only their covered criteria.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.OUTCOME_SEMANTICS: PASS means the precisely stated rule is met under its assumptions; FAIL means an observed/model/rule violation, UNKNOWN means insufficient evidence, NOT_APPLICABLE means guard false. For rejected candidates, the diagnostic classifies the overclaim as unsupported rather than proving every instance false.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.LIMIT: Some criteria admit mechanical checks; others need human/contextual evaluation. Process inventory completeness is a separate assumption.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: Criterion-specific user interaction/content evidence across all process steps. Third-party payment/authentication step cannot be inspected or assistive-technology support assumptions are missing.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Honor the precise conformance boundary and separately validate user needs not covered by the standard.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Normative criteria remain useful; a conformance result has limited scope.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: No universal user-need coverage or legal safe harbor follows.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retained only for its named bearer/trigger with the listed evidence ceiling and cheaper alternative. Honor the precise conformance boundary and separately validate user needs not covered by the standard.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Explicit sustainability effects, boundaries and time horizons

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Karlskrona2015 explicitly frames multiple dimensions, orders of effect and time; practitioner studies2016 and2025/2026 expose gaps between endorsement and implemented practice.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Sustainability design; direct, indirect and systemic effects; environmental/social/individual/economic/technical dimensions
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: An energy metric or agreeable sustainability statement can conceal displaced harms, rebound effects or incompatible horizons.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.

LOCATORS: Principles on dimensions, orders of effect, time and visibility

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. Karlskrona2015 explicitly frames multiple dimensions, orders of effect and time; practitioner studies2016 and2025/2026 expose gaps between endorsement and implemented practice.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A sustainability requirement is interpretable only with a declared effect, affected parties/system boundary, time horizon and evidence model; one metric cannot silently stand for all sustainability dimensions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A scoped sustainability claim and the causal/measurement boundary used to judge it.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: An energy metric or agreeable sustainability statement can conceal displaced harms, rebound effects or incompatible horizons.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Identify relevant dimensions and effects, distinguish direct measurements from hypothesized systemic consequences, and surface trade-offs before selecting thresholds.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use a small number of decision-relevant measures plus qualitative impact arguments and explicit unknowns; do not force all dimensions into one unsupported scalar.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Makes hidden trade-offs and evidence gaps visible to the decision owner.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Manifesto is normative advocacy; interview/survey studies identify perceptions and adoption obstacles, not measured benefit from this proposed property.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A scoped sustainability claim and the causal/measurement boundary used to judge it.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For a small local optimization, state its narrow energy/cost boundary and avoid a whole-sustainability claim; a short impact screen can decide whether deeper analysis is needed.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A requirement claims sustainability benefit or a choice materially affects long-lived environmental/social/economic/technical outcomes.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a small local optimization, state its narrow energy/cost boundary and avoid a whole-sustainability claim; a short impact screen can decide whether deeper analysis is needed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Causal links and affected populations can be described; chosen horizon and trade-off authority are explicit.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Declared system, lifecycle and effects; no automatic assertion that every project needs five complete metric programs.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Declared system, lifecycle and effects; no automatic assertion that every project needs five complete metric programs. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: Energy efficiency equals sustainability; practitioner agreement proves outcome improvement.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Stakeholder/mission values or adopted policy set priorities; manifesto advocacy does not supply binding thresholds.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Baseline, units, lifecycle boundary, population, horizon, measured versus modeled effects, allocation assumptions and decision rationale.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Benefits can reverse when workload, energy mix, retention, hardware lifecycle or behavior changes; record the conditional claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Lifecycle/systemic modeling can be expensive and uncertain; prioritize effects likely to change the decision.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: When the decision/effect path ends; re-enter after workload, boundary, horizon or stakeholder-priority changes.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Explicit sustainability effects, boundaries and time horizons
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Sustainability claim Δ × boundary B × horizon H × baseline M0 × evidence E
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Sustainability claim Δ × boundary B × horizon H × baseline M0 × evidence E. Rates/probabilities are in[0,1] when used; time, cost and loss units must be declared; no fixed universal threshold.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every material applicable instance in the explicitly declared set; an empty set is NOT_APPLICABLE or vacuous, not evidence of universal success. Declared system, lifecycle and effects; no automatic assertion that every project needs five complete metric programs.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A scoped sustainability claim and the causal/measurement boundary used to judge it.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Short-run efficiency and long-run adoption/rebound can differ; horizon is part of the claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Causal links and affected populations can be described; chosen horizon and trade-off authority are explicit.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A requirement claims sustainability benefit or a choice materially affects long-lived environmental/social/economic/technical outcomes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For each claimed sustainability improvement Δ, identify effect/baseline/unit, population/boundary and horizon; label observed versus inferred effects and record material trade-offs. Compare like with like. Return UNKNOWN for net/systemic benefit if only a narrow direct metric is measured.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Measured resource use for a defined workload plus separately justified indirect/systemic causal estimates.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Baseline, units, lifecycle boundary, population, horizon, measured versus modeled effects, allocation assumptions and decision rationale.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Domain/stakeholder impact review with measurement or lifecycle models proportionate to the decision.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Arithmetic over fixed measures is decidable; net systemic sustainability is assumption-sensitive and often unresolved.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed example: a smaller model reduces measured inference energy for a fixed workload while the record separately notes accuracy, access and rebound uncertainty.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed example: report lower joules per request as a net environmental gain despite a large increase in total requests and ignored hardware turnover.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Workload growth, displaced effects, affected population or causal baseline unknown.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A wording edit with no material effect path needs a brief no-impact rationale, not a lifecycle assessment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from boundary truncation; false rejection from demanding precise long-run estimates where a bounded qualitative claim is appropriate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Use sustainable as an unmeasurable adjective or combine incompatible dimensions with arbitrary weights.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Workload, resource mix, lifecycle boundary, horizon, causal assumption or value weighting changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Lifecycle/systemic modeling can be expensive and uncertain; prioritize effects likely to change the decision. For a small local optimization, state its narrow energy/cost boundary and avoid a whole-sustainability claim; a short impact screen can decide whether deeper analysis is needed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Manifesto is normative advocacy; interview/survey studies identify perceptions and adoption obstacles, not measured benefit from this proposed property. FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: This partition describes the named theoretical subclaim or counterexample. It is not independent replication, empirical efficacy, authority or whole-record proof. Original source access and proof-audit limits remain binding.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ACCESS_CEILING: Proposed data-dependent extension and case lessons; no validated general KAOS extension or measured law-enforcement outcome inferred. This is an RE representation/feasibility case, not endorsement of the deployment.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM: RefineML’s experience combines data/model feasibility and agile workstreams; perceived acceptance is not controlled evidence of process superiority.
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: Supports this named source-level component; the complete operational property is researcher synthesis.
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ACCESS_CEILING: Ten questionnaire respondents and two stakeholder interviews; perceived suitability and reported project progress without control group. Distinct software/model workstreams remain coupled; effort estimation and operationalization unresolved.

CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM: Training-data and monitor requirements interact with architecture; monitor overhead and dependency gaps constrain assurance.
CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: Limits or counters a stronger interpretation; not necessarily a refutation of the bounded retained claim.
CONTRARY_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ACCESS_CEILING: Ten interviews,17 challenges; six-member validation survey described in results. Relation mapping is qualitative interpretation, not a tested causal model. Monitors add latency, resource and false-positive costs; cannot simply move all safety obligations onto a monitor.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: ML engineering case studies treat data/model development as coupled;2026 data-dependent KAOS experience explicitly argues that label/data feasibility constrains goal modeling.
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITATIONS: Chronology is not by itself direct influence; genealogy edges separately distinguish documented relations from analogy.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: The principal claim is an empirical, institutional or qualitative judgment, not a theorem.
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: Graph reachability is decidable; completeness and semantic independence require judgment.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: N029 is an experience report proposing a modeling extension; N026/N028/N043 describe practice and difficulties. No controlled proof of a universal dependency schema.
EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: No comparison directly validates every clause of this researcher-proposed operational record; source-specific designs and baselines remain limiting.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of this entire reconstructed property was identified in the inspected bounded corpus.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.LIMITATIONS: Artifacts, repeated model runs and multiple publications on one dataset are not independent replications.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Field/context evidence is available but does not prove universal superiority.
INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.LIMITATIONS: Known material dependencies for the consuming requirement; not a complete data-governance program.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Constructed example: the model is retrained on a new population but the old evaluation report is retained because the requirement sentence did not change.
NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.LIMITATIONS: A source limitation or constructed example is not an observed incident. Negative direction and statistical certainty remain separate.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Data availability can reveal infeasibility; it does not itself authorize weakening a stakeholder obligation.
STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.LIMITATIONS: Official status and public text support only inspected provisions; adoption/application is separate.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.LIMITATIONS: Known material dependencies for the consuming requirement; not a complete data-governance program. Open-world dependencies and sociotechnical label validity cannot be exhaustively captured by a graph.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Validated semantic correspondence of machine-checkable requirements
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Source r/version × interpretation set I × representation φ × semantics S × witnesses W
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Source r/version × interpretation set I × representation φ × semantics S × witnesses W. Identifiers refer to versioned real artifacts/actors; context predicates require their own domain units. No arithmetic over arbitrary category codes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every material applicable instance in the explicitly declared set; an empty set is NOT_APPLICABLE or vacuous, not evidence of universal success. The expressed claim under declared semantics; not unexpressed stakeholder needs or truth of all domain assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A natural-language/domain-claim to machine representation correspondence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Time units, inclusive/exclusive bounds, finite/infinite traces and initial/final evaluation points are part of meaning.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Input scope and vocabulary are stable; reviewer understands the domain; representation can express the intended alternatives.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A textual/domain requirement is extracted, formalized, checked or used to generate tests/decisions automatically.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For representation φ of source claim r, record source evidence and candidate meanings; choose or retain alternatives using domain validation; check at least one satisfying and one violating discriminating witness under the declared semantics. If φ is merely parseable or satisfiable, do not infer semantic correspondence. If ambiguity remains material, return UNKNOWN or a set of alternatives.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Map domain occurrences/units/actors into variables and compare intended versus formal judgments on witnesses.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Domain-capable human validation plus parser, satisfiability/equivalence/model checker where appropriate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Formula equivalence may be decidable in a chosen logic; correspondence to open natural language/domain intent is not thereby decidable.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed example: acknowledge within two cycles is clarified to allow the current cycle; immediate, one-cycle, two-cycle and late traces distinguish it from exactly two cycles.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed example: every request eventually gets an acknowledgment is mistranslated as some request gets one; formula is satisfiable and tests derived from it repeat the error.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Source ambiguity, missing context/units, unsupported temporal operator or absent domain reviewer.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A qualitative goal about respectful service can use stakeholder scenarios and qualitative assessment rather than a misleading numerical/formal surrogate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from fluent explanation, shared translator/checker error or weak witnesses; false failure from rejecting a legitimate alternate interpretation without asking the owner.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A formula true on all traces, unreachable trigger or trivial witness set can pass checks without conveying the requirement.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Source, context, vocabulary, units, representation semantics, model/prompt/tool or interpretation decision changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Human review/correction, formal-language expertise and trace design; claimed tool savings must include this effort. A short qualitative requirement may be best reviewed through concrete examples and a structured statement; no AST, temporal logic or compiler is required.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: N032 demonstrates tool semantics; N033/N034 evaluate limited translation sets with explicit correction/oracle limits. N040 shows linguistic screening can complement review without proving absence of ambiguity. N044 strengthens the formal transformation lane: termination/well-formedness theorem and separate oracle-based semantic testing remain distinct from stakeholder validity. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Probabilistic FRET translation termination and output well-formedness
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Translation algorithm T × valid extended-FRETish field combination k
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: k ranges over valid combinations of scope, condition, probability and timing in N044; T is Algorithm1. wellformed_PCTLstar is syntactic membership in the paper’s PCTL* grammar. No external probability estimate or physical unit is inferred.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every valid input-field combination supported by the defined algorithm; not arbitrary natural-language input or unsupported nesting.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: The abstract translation algorithm and its output formula, not the deployed system.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Termination is algorithmic completion; output temporal/probabilistic operators have the paper’s declared PCTL* syntax. No unbounded external-system satisfaction follows.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Valid input combination; stated component composition and SALT translation behavior; implementation conforms to the abstract algorithm.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Use of the paper’s specified probabilistic FRET translation on supported fields.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: valid(k) ⇒ terminates(T(k)) ∧ wellformed_PCTLstar(T(k)). This is a concise reconstruction of Theorem1; all symbols are defined in the signature/domain fields.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: SOURCE_DEFINED theorem, paraphrased symbolically by researcher: N044 §4.3 Theorem1.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: For an implementation, map supported input fields to Algorithm1 and parse resulting formulas; this tests conformance but does not replace the proof.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Proof argument and component assumptions in §4.3; implementation/grammar version if claiming tool conformance.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Review the direct construction proof and finite template cases; separately test implementation outputs with a PCTL* parser.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Well-formedness is a syntactic property. The theorem is not a proof of natural-language interpretation or deployment probability validity.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Source worked example P-006 demonstrates construction; §4.3 extends the argument to valid combinations.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: A supported valid input producing a non-PCTL* output or nontermination would refute implementation conformance under the assumptions. No such observed counterexample is claimed here.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Unverified tool version, changed template/component translator or unsupported implementation behavior.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Arbitrary unstructured natural language, invalid field combinations or unsupported probabilistic nesting.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass if parseability is expanded into domain correctness; false failure if an invalid unsupported input is treated as a counterexample to the theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Restricting the input set to trivial keys hides coverage limits; every accepted output could still encode the wrong stakeholder interpretation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Revisit proof/conformance after grammar, algorithm, template, SALT component or semantic-definition changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Proof/component review plus conformance checks; for a simple claim use validated structured prose or a small executable test instead.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Termination and syntactic well-formedness for supported abstract inputs. N044’s nonexhaustive oracle/model tests are separate semantic-validation evidence; no guarantee of external/domain validity.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.PROCEDURE: Domain-capable human validation plus parser, satisfiability/equivalence/model checker where appropriate.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.OUTCOME_SEMANTICS: PASS means the precisely stated rule is met under its assumptions; FAIL means an observed/model/rule violation, UNKNOWN means insufficient evidence, NOT_APPLICABLE means guard false. For rejected candidates, the diagnostic classifies the overclaim as unsupported rather than proving every instance false.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.LIMIT: Formula equivalence may be decidable in a chosen logic; correspondence to open natural language/domain intent is not thereby decidable.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: Constructed example: acknowledge within two cycles is clarified to allow the current cycle; immediate, one-cycle, two-cycle and late traces distinguish it from exactly two cycles.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Constructed example: every request eventually gets an acknowledgment is mistranslated as some request gets one; formula is satisfiable and tests derived from it repeat the error.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE: A qualitative goal about respectful service can use stakeholder scenarios and qualitative assessment rather than a misleading numerical/formal surrogate.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: Map domain occurrences/units/actors into variables and compare intended versus formal judgments on witnesses. Source ambiguity, missing context/units, unsupported temporal operator or absent domain reviewer.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Source, context, vocabulary, units, representation semantics, model/prompt/tool or interpretation decision changes.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Formalization may make a wrong interpretation look authoritative and impose more review effort than direct human reasoning.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Constructed example: every request eventually gets an acknowledgment is mistranslated as some request gets one; formula is satisfiable and tests derived from it repeat the error. A formula true on all traces, unreachable trigger or trivial witness set can pass checks without conveying the requirement.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Separate lexical/syntactic/semantic/domain checks, keep source spans and use discriminating witnesses; choose a cheaper structured review when adequate.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Machine reasoning remains valuable about the chosen model; it cannot decide the intended social/domain meaning by itself.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: No general complete NL-to-formal translation or autonomous domain-valid requirement generation established.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: An AST, formula, generated test suite or tool PASS is not semantic validation.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retained only for its named bearer/trigger with the listed evidence ceiling and cheaper alternative. Separate lexical/syntactic/semantic/domain checks, keep source spans and use discriminating witnesses; choose a cheaper structured review when adequate.

These are related problem families, not one documented direct descent.
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITATIONS: Chronology is not by itself direct influence; genealogy edges separately distinguish documented relations from analogy.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.ASSESSMENT: N044, section 4.3, Theorem 1 concerns termination and a well-formed PCTL* output for the specified valid probabilistic FRETish input fields, with the stated SALT-termination assumption. It does not prove equivalence between arbitrary natural language, stakeholder intent and the generated formula. N032 remains a separate 2019 FRET presentation, not the source of this later theorem. A well-formed formula or a satisfying model need not admit a causal implementation under actual observations and controls. No universal realizability claim is adopted.
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: This partition describes the named theoretical subclaim or counterexample. It is not independent replication, empirical efficacy, authority or whole-record proof. Original source access and proof-audit limits remain binding.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: No comparison directly validates every clause of this researcher-proposed operational record; source-specific designs and baselines remain limiting.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Berry2017/2021 criticizes tool-only evaluation; QuARS cases include false-positive removal; recent LLM work exposes differences between benchmark accuracy, simulated review and observed human performance.

GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A tool may improve an output metric yet worsen human decisions, learning or total time after correction.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.
