Berry2017/2021 criticizes tool-only evaluation; QuARS cases include false-positive removal; recent LLM work exposes differences between benchmark accuracy, simulated review and observed human performance.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A claim that assistance improves requirements work needs evidence for the whole relevant workflow against a serious baseline, including human correction, omissions, uncertainty, total cost and model/data limits.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A comparative effectiveness claim for a specified human/tool workflow.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A tool may improve an output metric yet worsen human decisions, learning or total time after correction.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Evaluate final task outcomes and costs with comparable tasks/users, preserve error trade-offs, report model/prompts/data and distinguish simulated from observed assistance.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use risk-weighted precision/recall or task utility, credible human/non-LLM baselines and fresh or contamination-assessed data; include abstention and learning/skill effects when relevant.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Makes adoption decisions depend on achieved outcomes rather than impressive standalone outputs.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: N035 is a negative-direction novice crossover preprint with overlapping credible intervals. N034 supports benchmark/trace-count gains with simulated oracle limits. N040 supplies bounded positive case evidence. No uniform winner follows.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A comparative effectiveness claim for a specified human/tool workflow.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For occasional low-stakes drafting, compare a few representative tasks and manually review output; do not claim a general productivity effect from that pilot.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A tool/LLM is recommended or accepted because it allegedly saves time, improves correctness or replaces a human requirements activity.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For occasional low-stakes drafting, compare a few representative tasks and manually review output; do not claim a general productivity effect from that pilot.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Baseline is competent and comparable; outcome labels and loss trade-offs fit the actual task; evaluated users/models represent intended use.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Specified tasks, experience level, model/version, prompting/workflow and data; no automatic transfer to professional or safety-critical use.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Specified tasks, experience level, model/version, prompting/workflow and data; no automatic transfer to professional or safety-critical use. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: ARTEMIS trace-count reduction is observed human-time savings; nl2spec interactive accuracy is autonomous accuracy; one negative novice study condemns every LLM.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Research evidence informs adoption; it does not grant a model requirement-approval authority.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Study date, sample selection/size, tasks, labels, baselines, models/snapshots, prompts/configuration, interaction/correction traces, costs and contamination assessment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Opaque training data, model drift, weak oracle or unmeasured review effort reduces the ceiling of the claimed effect.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Evaluation costs can be significant; use smaller consequential pilots before broad comparative studies, but state their limited inference.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Re-evaluate after model/workflow/user/task distribution change or evidence of deterioration.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Computing measured effects is finite; causal/generalizable benefit depends on design and population assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Observed bounded example: QuARS case analysis includes human false-positive removal; benefit claim remains limited to those textual cases, not graphical requirements or universal savings.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Observed bounded example: a34-novice crossover finds no clear time benefit and a direction of lower inspection F1 with mixed GPT-4o/4.1 support; uncertainty and preprint status remain.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: No final human outcome, correction time, credible baseline, stable model identity or contamination assessment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A draft suggestion reviewed as ordinary brainstorming need not prove population-level productivity, provided no such claim or delegated acceptance follows.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from convenient benchmark/weak baseline; false failure from a human novice baseline inappropriate for the deployed expert workflow.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Measure easy formatting while claiming domain-valid requirements; omit expensive correction cases from time totals.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed model snapshot, prompts/tools, task domain, user expertise, training exposure or workflow.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Evaluation costs can be significant; use smaller consequential pilots before broad comparative studies, but state their limited inference. For occasional low-stakes drafting, compare a few representative tasks and manually review output; do not claim a general productivity effect from that pilot.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: N035 is a negative-direction novice crossover preprint with overlapping credible intervals. N034 supports benchmark/trace-count gains with simulated oracle limits. N040 supplies bounded positive case evidence. No uniform winner follows. Professional multi-organization longitudinal cost/quality evidence for current LLM requirements workflows remains a material gap.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: RESEARCHER_PROPOSED operational reconstruction from the linked sources; not quoted author notation or a theorem. The rule evaluates the stated evidence/decision relation, not every external outcome.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.PROCEDURE: Empirical study/pilot analysis with uncertainty, independent labels and appropriate baseline; replication if a concrete transfer risk warrants it.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.OUTCOME_SEMANTICS: PASS means the precisely stated rule is met under its assumptions; FAIL means an observed/model/rule violation, UNKNOWN means insufficient evidence, NOT_APPLICABLE means guard false. For rejected candidates, the diagnostic classifies the overclaim as unsupported rather than proving every instance false.
OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.LIMIT: Computing measured effects is finite; causal/generalizable benefit depends on design and population assumptions.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: Observed bounded example: QuARS case analysis includes human false-positive removal; benefit claim remains limited to those textual cases, not graphical requirements or universal savings.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Changed model snapshot, prompts/tools, task domain, user expertise, training exposure or workflow.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Full workflow studies are expensive and benchmarks can still be useful for comparing technical mechanisms.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Observed bounded example: a34-novice crossover finds no clear time benefit and a direction of lower inspection F1 with mixed GPT-4o/4.1 support; uncertainty and preprint status remain. HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Berry2017/2021 criticizes tool-only evaluation; QuARS cases include false-positive removal; recent LLM work exposes differences between benchmark accuracy, simulated review and observed human performance.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.ASSESSMENT: Workflow-evaluation arguments concern empirical comparison and costs. They do not establish semantic equivalence between generated and intended requirements. The inspected evaluations use particular documents, models, tasks and reference judgments. They do not establish that benchmark accuracy transfers unchanged to a new domain or current tool version.
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: This partition describes the named theoretical subclaim or counterexample. It is not independent replication, empirical efficacy, authority or whole-record proof. Original source access and proof-audit limits remain binding.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.LIMITATIONS: A source limitation or constructed example is not an observed incident. Negative direction and statistical certainty remain separate.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.LIMITATIONS: Official status and public text support only inspected provisions; adoption/application is separate.

EVIDENCE_CEILING.STRONGEST_SUPPORTED_CLAIM: N035 is a negative-direction novice crossover preprint with overlapping credible intervals. N034 supports benchmark/trace-count gains with simulated oracle limits. N040 supplies bounded positive case evidence. No uniform winner follows.

Professional multi-organization longitudinal cost/quality evidence for current LLM requirements workflows remains a material gap.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: No final human outcome, correction time, credible baseline, stable model identity or contamination assessment. Professional multi-organization longitudinal cost/quality evidence for current LLM requirements workflows remains a material gap.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Replicate with professional inspectors, immutable models, fresh domain requirements and end-to-end cost/learning outcomes.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: The reviewers inspected the complete claim/disposition population and selected detailed semantics/source bodies. Absence of an individual finding does not establish independent validation of every field, source or proposed predicate.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: ELIGIBLE_AS_CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE; apply only after independent target/context/authority analysis, not automatically.
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: What did the human+tool workflow improve over which serious baseline?
Who corrected the output and how much effort did it take?
How do model drift and training overlap limit the result?

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Executable human–AI responsibility and intervention allocation

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: NIST AI RMF1.0 explicitly distinguishes human-AI configurations and oversight responsibilities; critical-ML practice and negative collaboration evidence challenge ceremonial human oversight.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Human-AI configurations; MAP3.5; oversight processes
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A nominal human in the loop may lack time, information, authority or capability to prevent a consequential system failure.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. NIST AI RMF1.0 explicitly distinguishes human-AI configurations and oversight responsibilities; critical-ML practice and negative collaboration evidence challenge ceremonial human oversight.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Where human intervention is part of satisfying a system requirement, the required decision, information, timing, authority and fallback must be allocated and tested as part of the combined system.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A human/software/model/tool/organization allocation for a consequential decision.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A nominal human in the loop may lack time, information, authority or capability to prevent a consequential system failure.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Specify which actor decides or acts under which conditions, what evidence and time are available, and what the system does when intervention is unavailable or ineffective.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat autonomy as a scoped configuration; validate combined performance and allow fully automatic low-consequence cases without pointless approval rituals.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Exposes gaps that local model or monitor metrics cannot cover.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: N030 is voluntary guidance and acknowledges varied configurations; N028 andN035 show why adding a monitor or human does not by itself establish better performance.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A human/software/model/tool/organization allocation for a consequential decision.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For reversible low-consequence automation such as benign format conversion, define a simple recovery path without requiring approval of every output.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A system requirement relies on escalation, review, override, tool authorization or human judgment under uncertainty.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For reversible low-consequence automation such as benign format conversion, define a simple recovery path without requiring approval of every output.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Assigned actors are available, trained and authorized; intervention latency and information quality fit the hazard/decision window.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Specified human-AI configuration and operating conditions; no blanket claim humans always improve outcomes or all autonomy requires oversight.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Specified human-AI configuration and operating conditions; no blanket claim humans always improve outcomes or all autonomy requires oversight. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: Human review guarantees safety; a better model score implies a better human-AI system.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Organizational/domain policy assigns decision rights; model confidence does not grant new tool or requirement-changing powers.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Decision/action map, authorization scope, evidence shown, latency/workload assumptions, escalation/fallback and combined-system evaluation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: If the human cannot intervene in time, the supposed mitigation is unavailable; fallback or narrowed autonomy must address that case.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Staffing, training, alert workload and latency; excessive review can reduce attention and usefulness.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: When intervention is no longer relied on; re-enter after workload, tool permission, model behavior, interface or staffing changes.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.INTENDED_MEANING: Who may decide, execute, revise or override in each relevant state
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: A human/software/model/tool/organization allocation for a consequential decision.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.UNIT_OR_SCALE: Categorical/relational record; time/physical units are declared in the underlying domain requirement rather than invented here.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.ALLOWED_VALUES_OR_CONSTRAINTS: Versioned known value with provenance, explicit UNKNOWN with reason, or NOT_APPLICABLE with guard rationale; no silent empty-as-pass convention.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.QUANTITATIVE_OR_QUALITATIVE: Mixed quantitative/qualitative as the named metric requires
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.OBSERVED_DERIVED_ASSUMED_OR_STIPULATED: Schema is researcher-proposed; actual instance values must distinguish observed records, derived judgments, assumptions and authorized stipulations.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every material applicable instance in the explicitly declared set; an empty set is NOT_APPLICABLE or vacuous, not evidence of universal success. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A proposed inference from generated artifact properties to an authoritative requirement set.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A proposal would accept or implement generated requirements solely because they look coherent or pass generated/formal checks.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Diagnostic rule: if the only evidence for requirement authority/domain validity is generated coherence, syntactic/formal pass or a benchmark score, classify that sufficiency claim UNSUPPORTED/REJECTED. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Claim-source links and independence of validation, rather than style or token confidence.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Evidence/authority review with adversarial alternative interpretations.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Detecting absent independent evidence in a finite packet is possible; proving universal generated completeness is not established.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed witness for the diagnostic: generated requirement and generated tests agree but no stakeholder/source supports an invented retention policy; the sufficiency claim is rejected.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Counterexample to the rejected candidate: a perfectly satisfiable formula encodes a different time interpretation from the stakeholder’s intended one.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Potential independent authority/domain evidence exists but cannot be inspected; retain UNKNOWN rather than declare the underlying requirement false.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A validated structured template with authorized fixed fields can be mechanically rendered without claiming the renderer discovered new requirements.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: New independent validation may change the narrow claim disposition; mere model upgrade or reformatted output does not.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Rejected universal failure rates from requirements anecdotes and surveys

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Incident narratives and RE surveys are repeatedly used to motivate process prescriptions; primary survey and board reports require narrower interpretations.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Requirements problems; reported causes/effects; root and contributing causes
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Source-specific formulation recorded in the linked original works; this record separates the reusable mechanism from named method/notation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A requirements label can compress interacting organizational/technical failures into one cause or a universal percentage.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: See typed genealogy_edges; shared purpose alone is not direct influence.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim of first invention outside the inspected sources. Incident narratives and RE surveys are repeatedly used to motivate process prescriptions; primary survey and board reports require narrower interpretations.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Candidate rejected: selected incidents or respondents’ reported requirements problems establish a universal fraction of project failures caused by poor requirements, or prove a specific RE ceremony would have prevented them.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A population-level causal or counterfactual effectiveness claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A requirements label can compress interacting organizational/technical failures into one cause or a universal percentage.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: The rejected inference extrapolates from selected cases/self-reports without a defined denominator, counterfactual or causal identification.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Replacement: preserve incident-specific mechanisms and survey frequencies as bounded hypotheses; require appropriate comparative/causal evidence for preventive-effect claims.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids false certainty while retaining actionable failure mechanisms.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: N041 explicitly labels cause-effect diagrams as citation frequencies rather than probabilities. N042 records both an existing metric-units requirement and implementation/coordination failures. Neither estimates a universal requirements failure fraction.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The actor deciding whether the named claim may be accepted, changed, reused or relied upon: A population-level causal or counterfactual effectiveness claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use a concrete incident as an illustrative risk mechanism with its limitations; no causal prevalence estimate is needed to ask whether the same mechanism is possible here.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A historical failure or survey statistic is used to justify universal process effectiveness, mandatory ceremony or an exact failure percentage.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use a concrete incident as an illustrative risk mechanism with its limitations; no causal prevalence estimate is needed to ask whether the same mechanism is possible here.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A causal prevalence claim would require a defined population, inclusion criteria, reliable attribution and suitable counterfactual/design.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Reject overgeneralization; do not deny that requirements failures can cause serious consequences.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Reject overgeneralization; do not deny that requirements failures can cause serious consequences. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: Requirements never cause failures; all failures are requirements failures; incident recurrence proves a universal method effect.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Research statistics/incident findings do not themselves mandate a chosen process; decision authority and applicability are separate.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Candidate assigned during inspection of Agile principles (2001), dual-track practice (2020), and 2026 large-scale/ML experience; this mandatory interpretation is a researcher candidate, not an author quotation.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A claimed universal organizational prescription for requirements work.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A useful coordination mechanism is turned into a universal organizational mandate without regard to task coupling, cost or existing feedback.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Preserve the change/evidence and coordination mechanism in C0201; choose organizational form according to the actual coordination problem.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For one small team, connect discovery evidence to the same backlog/change decision without creating a second organizational track.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A process recommendation treats a named organizational form or meeting cadence as mandatory across contexts.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For one small team, connect discovery evidence to the same backlog/change decision without creating a second organizational track.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A necessity claim would require showing that viable simpler organizations fail under the relevant scope; shared terminology alone cannot supply that evidence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Only the proposed mandatory form is evaluated. Contextual usefulness of dual-track work is not rejected.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Only the proposed mandatory form is evaluated. Contextual usefulness of dual-track work is not rejected. Excluded or unsupported stronger claims: All dual-track use is ineffective; every project needs two tracks; meeting completion establishes valid requirements.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: No external norm mandates these ceremonies in the inspected sources. A local organization may adopt a form, but that is separate from universal engineering necessity.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: If the same evidence and coordination are already available more cheaply, the mandatory-form inference fails.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Additional meetings, handoffs and duplicate backlogs can consume time; their costs must be tied to the problem they solve.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Retire the universal prescription; reopen only for a defined context with comparative evidence or an applicable local mandate.

Choose the easiest boundary and omit the activities whose impacts rose.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Net sustainability outcomes are not established by the perception studies in this corpus.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: A carbon dashboard or green score without effect/boundary disclosure is a proxy.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: SUPERSEDED_BY_STRONGER_FORM C0209; retain useful narrow energy measures with explicit boundaries, and preserve this incomplete candidate in the population.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: Supports the explicitly stated source-level component or limitation. It does not establish the candidate’s stronger claim or change its recorded disposition.

SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.CLAIM: Mixed-method practitioner evidence reports implementation barriers; self-report and sampling limits prevent net sustainability-effect inference.
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ROLE: Supports the explicitly stated source-level component or limitation. It does not establish the candidate’s stronger claim or change its recorded disposition.
SUPPORTING_CLAIM_SOURCE_LINKS.ACCESS_CEILING: Eight interviews and203 valid survey respondents support perceived-practice analysis, not demonstrated environmental or social improvement. Prolific selection, self-report, desirability and AI-response screening limit interpretation.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Assigned from the sustainability trajectory: Karlskrona2015, requirements practice2016 and ML-practitioner2025/2026 evidence.
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.LIMITATIONS: Chronology is not by itself direct influence; genealogy edges separately distinguish documented relations from analogy.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: The principal claim is an empirical, institutional or qualitative judgment, not a theorem.
FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: The specified metric can be computed under its model; completeness of all future effects is not thereby decidable.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: The manifesto distinguishes dimensions and effect horizons. The2016 and ML-practitioner studies concern practice/perception rather than proof that a single metric captures total sustainability.
EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.LIMITATIONS: No comparison directly validates every clause of this researcher-proposed operational record; source-specific designs and baselines remain limiting.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of this entire reconstructed property was identified in the inspected bounded corpus.
REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.LIMITATIONS: Artifacts, repeated model runs and multiple publications on one dataset are not independent replications.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Field/context evidence is available but does not prove universal superiority.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: No direct field counterexample to the bounded reconstructed claim was located; constructed witnesses test its intended meaning.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Stakeholder/domain decisions define acceptable effects and tradeoffs; the manifesto is advocacy, not binding law or an empirical effect guarantee.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.LIMITATIONS: Tool/method descriptions establish available mechanisms; reports of perceived usefulness are not measured task-outcome effects.

NORMATIVE_SOURCE_AUTHORITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: A complete assignment must satisfy the entire propositional formula. Pairwise-compatible constraints can still be jointly inconsistent, as the preserved three-formula counterexample demonstrates.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
REFINEMENT_CORRECTNESS.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

REALIZABILITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: A satisfiable feature assignment is a model configuration, not a causal implementation or evidence of adequate resources and runtime behavior.
REALIZABILITY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
REALIZABILITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Constraints give feature relations exact model meaning. No empirical completeness or accuracy rate for an arbitrary feature model's requirement links follows.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
TRACEABILITY_ACCURACY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: A valid configuration may fail the external need or an acceptance criterion not represented in the feature model.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
ACCEPTANCE_CORRESPONDENCE.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: The FODA feasibility experience and anticipated economics do not demonstrate universal comparative reuse benefit; the recorded exercise's architecture-analysis limitation remains.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
EMPIRICAL_PROCESS_EFFECTIVENESS.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.STRENGTH_AND_JUSTIFICATION: Whole-formula evaluation correctly distinguishes valid from invalid assignments in the declared model. It does not validate omitted constraints, stakeholder utility or future model changes.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.ASSESSMENT_ORIGIN: SPR-L3 current author assessment of the named subclaim; historical source access reused unless a current access event is separately bound.
DECISION_MODEL_VALIDITY.EVIDENCE_ROLE: Assessed basis, possibly contrary or access-limited; not an automatic positive-support list.

EVIDENCE_CEILING.STRONGEST_SUPPORTED_CLAIM: Retain formal validity within explicit domain boundaries and use targeted models where variation actually matters.
EVIDENCE_CEILING.STRONGER_CLAIMS_WITHHELD: No universal reuse benefit or guarantee of complete domain modeling.

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Logical configuration validity; physical compatibility, legal applicability and customer fitness need additional evidence.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: A current family case with independent validation of feature meanings and maintenance burden.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: A current family case with independent validation of feature meanings and maintenance burden.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: The reviewers inspected the complete claim/disposition population and selected detailed semantics/source bodies. Absence of an individual finding does not establish independent validation of every field, source or proposed predicate.

REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.COMMON_OR_VARIABLE_STATEMENT: A statement can be common within a specified family and optional outside it; family scope is part of its meaning.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.SELECTION_CONDITION: Boolean feature predicate over a named configuration and context; unknown applicability is not optionality.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.DEPENDENCIES: Represent required implications and binding stages; B implies A is the finite witness.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.EXCLUSIONS: Mutual exclusions and deployment-specific restrictions must be stated, not inferred from a template.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.INHERITED_ASSUMPTIONS: Retain provenance, units, populations, authority and operating conditions when copying or instantiating a requirement.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.CONFIGURATION_SCOPE: Source/destination family, customer, jurisdiction, environment and lifecycle stage where material.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.VALIDATION: Check the declared constraint conjunction and separately review model-to-context correspondence.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.CHANGE_IMPACT: A changed constraint can invalidate previously accepted configurations and their test oracles even if test text is unchanged.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.CHEAPER_COMPARATORS: Fresh elicitation for a weak similarity; direct checking or regeneration for a tiny feature family.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.LIMIT: No universal reuse benefit or guarantee of complete domain modeling.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_TRIGGER: A family has actual optional/alternative features or cross-feature constraints.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.BEARER: A feature-model version and a feature selection
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.SEMANTIC_RULE: For complete selection v over feature set F, PASS iff the conjunction phi(v) of the versioned feature constraints is true. Partial assignment with undecided relevant constraints is UNKNOWN. A separate mapping review asks whether phi captures the intended family.
REQUIREMENT_VARIABILITY_PROFILE.AUTHORITY: A valid feature choice is not necessarily permitted for every customer or jurisdiction.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: ELIGIBLE_WITH_APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Logical configuration validity; physical compatibility, legal applicability and customer fitness need additional evidence.
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: What evidence establishes the applicability guard for this subject?
Which decision changes if this mechanism or its cheaper alternative is absent?
A current family case with independent validation of feature meanings and maintenance burden.
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: No universal reuse benefit or guarantee of complete domain modeling.
No target adoption, repository owner allocation or cross-lineage agreement is established.
SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES: Depends on contextual applicability and versioned constraint semantics; complements, but does not replace, external validation.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A test or expected result tied to one feature-model version must be reconsidered when changed constraints alter valid configurations; the best update policy depends on the kind of change and the cost model.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A previously passing test continues to be treated as current evidence after its oracle has changed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Bind each test oracle to the model version, classify semantic changes and evaluate regeneration versus adaptation against the current validity relation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use change-sensitive policy choice and retain a simple regeneration path for small models.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids treating obsolete expectations as assurance of the changed family.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: R010 evaluates conditional policy tradeoffs; its cost metrics and scalability limits restrict the benefit claim. R06 verifies a finite stale-oracle witness.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The maintainer choosing which existing tests remain informative after a family change.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For a tiny model, regenerate or manually review a few configurations instead of maintaining an elaborate adaptation system.
